```csharp
        private Panel BuildPayablesBox()
        {
            var box = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 254,
                Margin = new Padding(10, 0, 10, 10),
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
                Padding = new Padding(14, 12, 14, 12),
            };

            var header = new Label
            {
                Text = "Payables",
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 24,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText,
            };

            _cartStatusLabel = new Label
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 20,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill,
            };

            var summaryTable = new TableLayoutPanel { Dock = DockStyle.Fill, ColumnCount = 2, RowCount = 5 };
            summaryTable.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent, 55f));
            summaryTable.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent, 45f));

            Label MakeCaption(string text) => new() { Text = text, Dock = DockStyle.Fill, Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f), ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted, TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft };
            Label MakeValue() => new() { Text = "₱0.00", Dock = DockStyle.Fill, Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11f), ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText, TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleRight };

            _subTotalValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _discountValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _vatValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _pwdSeniorValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _totalValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _totalValueLabel.ForeColor = BrandPalette.Brand;
            _totalValueLabel.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(15f);

            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("Subtotal"), 0, 0);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_subTotalValueLabel, 1, 0);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("Discount"), 0, 1);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_discountValueLabel, 1, 1);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("VAT (12%)"), 0, 2);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_vatValueLabel, 1, 2);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("PWD/Senior Disc."), 0, 3);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_pwdSeniorValueLabel, 1, 3);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("Total"), 0, 4);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_totalValueLabel, 1, 4);

            box.Controls.Add(summaryTable);
            box.Controls.Add(_cartStatusLabel);
            box.Controls.Add(header);

            return box;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // CUSTOMER SELECTION
        // =====================================================================

        private void RunCustomerSearch()
        {
            var query = _customerSearchTxtBx.Text.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query))
                return;

            var match = _customerService.FindByPhoneOrId(query);
            if (match is null)
            {
                _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = $"No customer found for \"{query}\".";
                _customerProfilePanel.Visible = false;
                return;
            }

            _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = string.Empty;
            ShowCustomerProfile(match);
            SelectCustomer(match);
        }

        private void ShowCustomerProfile(Customer customer)
        {
            _customerProfileNameLabel.Text = customer.FullName;
            _customerProfileDetailLabel.Text = $"{customer.Tier} Tier   •   {customer.PointsBalance} pts\n{customer.ContactNumber}";
            _customerProfilePanel.Visible = true;
        }

        private void SelectCustomer(Customer customer)
        {
            var employeeId = EmployeeSession.Current?.EmployeeId
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No employee session — the Transaction view requires a logged-in employee.");

            // Search-and-Go = start a fresh transaction. If the existing cart has items, confirm
            // first — a staff member mid-sale who mistypes a customer ID shouldn't lose their work
            // silently. Empty carts (or no VM yet) just get replaced without asking.
            if (_transactionViewModel is not null && _transactionViewModel.CartItems.Count > 0)
            {
                var currentCustomerName = _transactionViewModel.Customer.FullName;
                var confirm = MessageBox.Show(
                    FindForm(),
                    $"Discard the in-progress order for {currentCustomerName} and start a new one for {customer.FullName}?",
                    "Start New Transaction",
                    MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);

                if (confirm != DialogResult.Yes)
                {
                    _customerSearchTxtBx.Text = _transactionViewModel.Customer.CustomerId.ToString();
                    return;
                }
            }

            _transactionViewModel = new TransactionViewModel(_orderService, _catalogService, ServiceRegistry.Campaigns, customer, employeeId);
            _transactionViewModel.SaleCompleted += (s, e) => OnSaleCompleted();
            _transactionViewModel.OperationFailed += (s, message) => ShowCartStatus(message);
            _transactionViewModel.PropertyChanged += TransactionViewModel_PropertyChanged;
            _transactionViewModel.VisibleProducts.ListChanged += (s, e) => RefreshProductsPanel();
            _transactionViewModel.CartItems.ListChanged += (s, e) => RefreshCartLines();

            RefreshProductsPanel();
            RefreshCartLines();
            RefreshSummary();
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // DRINKS / CART / CHECKOUT
        // =====================================================================

        private void TransactionViewModel_PropertyChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.PropertyName is nameof(TransactionViewModel.SubTotal) or nameof(TransactionViewModel.TotalDiscount) or nameof(TransactionViewModel.TotalAmount))
                RefreshSummary();

            if (e.PropertyName == nameof(TransactionViewModel.Customer))
                ShowCustomerProfile(_transactionViewModel!.Customer);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Opens the "choose a promo" menu above the promo row. Menu items apply the promo on
        /// click; a "Clear applied promo" item appears when a promo is currently applied, and
        /// selecting it removes the promo (same path as setting the combo to index 0).
        /// </summary>
        private void ShowPromoMenu()
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
                return;

            var menu = new ContextMenuStrip();

            if (_transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems.Count > 0)
            {
                var clear = menu.Items.Add("Clear applied promo");
                clear.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9f);
                clear.Click += (s, e) => _transactionViewModel.ClearPromos();
                menu.Items.Add(new ToolStripSeparator());
            }

            if (_transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos.Count == 0)
            {
                var none = menu.Items.Add("No promos available for this order");
                none.Enabled = false;
            }
            else
            {
                foreach (var campaign in _transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos)
                {
                    var alreadyApplied = _transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems
                        .Any(r => r.CampaignId == campaign.CampaignId);

                    var label = campaign.DiscountType == "Percentage"
                        ? $"{campaign.PromoName} — {campaign.DiscountValue:0.##}% off"
                        : $"{campaign.PromoName} — ₱{campaign.DiscountValue:0.##} off";
                    if (alreadyApplied)
                        label += "  (applied)";

                    var item = menu.Items.Add(label);
                    item.Enabled = !alreadyApplied;
                    item.Click += (s, e) => _transactionViewModel.ApplyPromoCommand.Execute(campaign);
                }
            }

            menu.Show(_promoMenuBtn, new Point(0, _promoMenuBtn.Height));
        }

        private void RefreshPromoCombo()
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                _promoCombo.Items.Clear();
                _promoCombo.Enabled = false;
                _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            var currentId = (_promoCombo.SelectedItem as PromoItem)?.Campaign?.CampaignId;

            _suppressPromoApply = true;

            _promoCombo.Items.Clear();
            _promoCombo.Items.Add(new PromoItem(null, "Select a Promo"));
            foreach (var campaign in _transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos)
            {
                var label = campaign.DiscountType == "Percentage"
                    ? $"{campaign.PromoName} — {campaign.DiscountValue:0.##}% off"
                    : $"{campaign.PromoName} — ₱{campaign.DiscountValue:0.##} off";
                _promoCombo.Items.Add(new PromoItem(campaign, label));
            }

            var restoredIndex = 0;
            if (currentId.HasValue)
            {
                for (int i = 1; i < _promoCombo.Items.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (_promoCombo.Items[i] is PromoItem pi && pi.Campaign?.CampaignId == currentId.Value)
                    {
                        restoredIndex = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            _promoCombo.SelectedIndex = restoredIndex;
            _suppressPromoApply = false;
            _promoCombo.Enabled = true;
            _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = true;
        }

        private void RefreshSummary()
        {
            RefreshPromoCombo();

            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                _subTotalValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _discountValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _vatValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _pwdSeniorValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _totalValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _logSaleBtn.Enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            _subTotalValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.SubTotal:0.00}";
            _discountValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.TotalDiscount:0.00}";
            _vatValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.TotalAmount * VatRate:0.00}";
            _pwdSeniorValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
            _totalValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.TotalAmount:0.00}";
            _logSaleBtn.Enabled = _transactionViewModel.CompleteSaleCommand.CanExecute(null);
        }

        private void BuildCategoryOptions()
        {
            _categoryCombo.Items.Clear();
            _categoryCombo.Items.Add(AllCategoriesOption);
            foreach (var category in _catalogService.GetCategories())
                _categoryCombo.Items.Add(category);
            _categoryCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        private void RefreshProductsPanel()
        {
            _productsFlowPanel.Controls.Clear();
            if (_transactionViewModel is null) return;

            foreach (var product in _transactionViewModel.VisibleProducts)
            {
                var card = new ProductCardControl(product);
                card.CardClicked += (s, e) => OpenCustomizerForNewItem(product);
                card.SizeQuickAdded += (s, size) => QuickAddToCart(product, size);
                _productsFlowPanel.Controls.Add(card);
            }
        }

        private void QuickAddToCart(Product product, ProductSize size)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                ShowCartStatus("Pick a customer on the left first.");
                return;
            }

            _transactionViewModel.AddItemToCart(product, size, 1, Enumerable.Empty<ProductModifier>());
        }

        private void OpenCustomizerForNewItem(Product product)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                ShowCartStatus("Pick a customer on the left first.");
                return;
            }

            var customizerViewModel = new ItemCustomizerViewModel(product, _catalogService.GetModifiers());
            using var form = new FrmItemCustomizer(customizerViewModel);

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                _transactionViewModel.AddItemToCart(product, customizerViewModel.SelectedSize, customizerViewModel.Quantity, customizerViewModel.SelectedModifiers);
            }
        }

        private void OpenCustomizerForEdit(OrderItem item)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null || item.Product is null) return;

            var customizerViewModel = new ItemCustomizerViewModel(item.Product, _catalogService.GetModifiers(), item);
            using var form = new FrmItemCustomizer(customizerViewModel);

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                _transactionViewModel.UpdateCartItem(item, customizerViewModel.SelectedSize, customizerViewModel.Quantity, customizerViewModel.SelectedModifiers);
            }
        }

        private void RefreshCartLines()
        {
            _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Clear();

            if (_transactionViewModel is null || _transactionViewModel.CartItems.Count == 0)
            {
                _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Add(_cartEmptyLabel);
                return;
            }

            var lineWidth = Math.Max(200,
                _cartLinesPanel.ClientSize.Width - SystemInformation.VerticalScrollBarWidth - 8);

            foreach (var item in _transactionViewModel.CartItems)
            {
                var line = new CartLineControl(item) { Width = lineWidth };
                line.QuantityIncreased += (s, e) => ChangeQuantity(item, +1);
                line.QuantityDecreased += (s, e) => ChangeQuantity(item, -1);
                line.RemoveClicked += (s, e) => _transactionViewModel!.RemoveItemCommand.Execute(item);
                _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Add(line);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The Order box's inline "-"/"+" stepper. TransactionViewModel has no dedicated
        /// "just change the quantity" method — UpdateCartItem needs the real ProductSize and
        /// ProductModifier domain objects, not just the OrderItem's snapshotted values, so
        /// they're looked back up from the catalog here. Dropping to 0 removes the line.
        /// </summary>
        private void ChangeQuantity(OrderItem item, int delta)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null || item.Product is null) return;

            var newQuantity = item.Quantity + delta;
            if (newQuantity <= 0)
            {
                _transactionViewModel.RemoveItemCommand.Execute(item);
                return;
            }

            var size = item.Product.ProductSizes.First(s => s.ProductSizeId == item.ProductSizeId);
            var modifiers = _catalogService.GetModifiers()
                .Where(m => item.OrderItemModifiers.Any(om => om.ProductModifierId == m.ProductModifierId));

            _transactionViewModel.UpdateCartItem(item, size, newQuantity, modifiers);
        }

        private void ShowCartStatus(string message) => _cartStatusLabel.Text = message;

        private void OnSaleCompleted()
        {
            var vm = _transactionViewModel!;
            MessageBox.Show(FindForm(),
                $"Sale completed. {vm.Order.PointsEarned} points awarded to {vm.Customer.FullName}.",
                "Sale Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

            _transactionViewModel = null;
            _customerProfilePanel.Visible = false;
            _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = string.Empty;
            _customerSearchTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
            RefreshProductsPanel();
            RefreshCartLines();
            RefreshSummary();
        }
    }
}
```

---

**What changed vs. what you pasted:**

1. **`BuildCustomerColumn()`** — the `column` was never being created. I added the `var column = new Panel { ... };` at the top of the method (it was missing from your paste). The final `column.Controls.Add(...)` sequence now adds `promoRow` instead of the orphan `_promoCombo`.
2. **`ShowPromoMenu()`** — added as a full method, right before `RefreshPromoCombo()`. It was referenced by the button's click handler but not defined.
3. **Field block** — moved `_promoCombo`, `_promoMenuBtn`, `_suppressPromoApply` down with the other left-column fields for readability. Same names, just reorganized.
4. **`RefreshPromoCombo()`** — added `_promoMenuBtn.Enabled = false/true` alongside `_promoCombo.Enabled` so the Choose button disables when there's no active transaction.

Everything else is identical to what you had. Copy the whole thing over your `TransactionView.cs` and rebuild.

**Quick verify after you build:**

- The Choose ▾ button should appear in the bottom-right of the left column, beside the promo combo.
- Clicking it opens a menu; with no customer picked, the menu shows "No promos available for this order."
- After picking a customer, "Choose ▾" lists eligible promos; picking one applies it and the combo shows it.
- Adding items to the cart should now recalc the Discount value (that's the domain fix from last round — `Order.RecalculateTotals` re-evaluates from `redeem.Campaign.CalculateDiscount(SubTotal)`).

Good — now I can see the actual file, and I was wrong about which fix was in place. The file **does** have the Label swap (the ✕ is `_removeLabel`, a `Label`). So the ✕ is not a Button. That means the visual problem is something else entirely.

Let me look at the layout math:

```text
RowHeight = 44
NameHeight = 22
StepperButtonSize = 30
QtyLabelWidth = 34
StepperClusterWidth = 30 + 34 + 30 = 94
GapBeforeRemove = 10
RemoveWidth = 28
RightClusterWidth = 94 + 10 + 28 = 132
```

Inside `rightCluster`:

- `_stepper` at `(0, 0)`, width 94, height 44 (full row). Inside it, a FlowLayoutPanel with `Padding = (0, 7, 0, 7)` — so 30px of content height for 30px-tall buttons. Good.
- `_removeLabel` at `(RightClusterWidth - RemoveWidth, 0)` = `(132 - 28, 0)` = `(104, 0)`, width 28, height 44.

So the stepper occupies x=0..94 of the cluster, remove occupies 104..132. **There's a 10px gap between them (94..104). That looks correct on paper.**

But the screenshot shows the ✕ pressed up against the `+`, with the `+` itself looking squeezed. Let me look more carefully at what I'm seeing...

**The `+` button itself is narrower than the `-` button.** That's the actual visual bug. In the screenshot: `-` is a clean square, `+` is a thin vertical rectangle. Same code, same `MakeStepperButton`, same size... but rendered differently.

**That's not a layout bug — that's a WinForms Flat Button minimum-width issue again, applied to `+` rather than ✕.** The `+` button's default rendering has a certain "minimum content area" and when the parent FlowLayoutPanel is squeezed, WinForms truncates the *later* children first. So the `+` (last child of the stepper) gets squeezed because the stepper's available width is less than `94`.

Why would the stepper's width be less than `94`? It's `_stepper.Width = 94` — set explicitly. Unless...

**Wait. Look at the actual screenshot again.** The `+` is thin *and* the ✕ is right next to it, and there's no gap. So `_removeLabel` must be at x ≈ 94+something small, not x = 104. That means `RightClusterWidth` isn't 132 at the moment layout runs, or `_removeLabel.Location` is being computed against a stale width.

**Here's the actual bug.** Look at the layout order in `LayoutChildren()`:

```csharp
_rightCluster.Location = new Point(width - RightClusterWidth, 0);
_removeLabel.Location = new Point(RightClusterWidth - RemoveWidth, 0);
```

`_removeLabel.Location` is set relative to **`RightClusterWidth`** — which is a **constant** (132). But `_removeLabel`'s parent is `_rightCluster`, whose **actual** width is whatever you set on it, which is also `RightClusterWidth`. So `_removeLabel` lands at `(104, 0)` inside a 132-wide cluster. That's correct **as long as the cluster width wasn't changed**.

But is it changed? `_rightCluster.Width = RightClusterWidth` in the constructor, and `LayoutChildren()` only sets its **Location**, not its **Width**. So width stays 132. Fine.

Hmm. So the math is right. Then why does the render look wrong?

**Two possibilities I can see:**

**(a)** `_stepper.Width = StepperClusterWidth = 94` — but the FlowLayoutPanel has `Padding = (0, 7, 0, 7)` which **reduces the content area** to 44 - 14 = 30px height and (94 - 0) = 94px width. So the content area is 94px wide. Inside that, three children at widths 30, 34, 30 = 94. That fits **exactly, edge to edge**. No margin. In WinForms FlowLayoutPanel, children with default margin (`new Padding(3)`) get *additional* spacing — so 30+3+34+3+30 = 100, which is **wider than 94**. The last child (`+`) gets squeezed/clipped because there's no room.

**That's the bug.** `MakeStepperButton` doesn't set `Margin`, so it defaults to `new Padding(3)` on all sides. The qtyLabel also doesn't set `Margin`, same default. Total effective width: 30+6 (margin) + 34+6 + 30+6 = 112 > 94. So the `+` gets pushed past the right edge of the stepper and clipped, and the ✕ (which is at cluster x=104) sits right on top of / next to the squeezed `+`.

**Fix:** set `Margin = new Padding(0)` on the stepper's children, or widen the stepper by the margin amount.

**Cleanest fix:** `Margin = new Padding(0)` on `minusBtn`, `qtyLabel`, `plusBtn`, and increase `StepperClusterWidth` is not needed then. With zero margins, content is exactly 94px and fits.

Actually the cleanest is even simpler: set the FlowLayoutPanel's own `Margin` on each child to zero, AND bump `Padding` to center vertically. Let me spell it out.

---

## Fix — `CartLineControl.cs`

Two changes:

**Change 1** — `MakeStepperButton`, add `Margin = new Padding(0)`:

```csharp
private static Button MakeStepperButton(string text) => new()
{
    Text = text,
    Width = StepperButtonSize,
    Height = StepperButtonSize,
    Margin = new Padding(0),            // ← FlowLayoutPanel default margin (3px each side) was
                                        // squeezing the trailing + button out of the 94px stepper
    FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
    BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
    ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryText,
    Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(10f),
    Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
};
```

**Change 2** — the qtyLabel, same `Margin = new Padding(0)`:

```csharp
var qtyLabel = new Label
{
    Text = $"{item.Quantity}x",
    Width = QtyLabelWidth,
    Height = StepperButtonSize,
    Margin = new Padding(0),            // ← same reason
    TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter,
    Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(10f),
    ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText,
};
```

**That's it.** With both children marginless, 30+34+30 = 94 fits exactly in the 94px stepper. The `+` renders at full width. The ✕ at cluster x=104 sits a real 10px gap away from the stepper's right edge (stepper ends at x=94, ✕ starts at x=104).

**Replace `ShowPromoMenu()`** with:

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Opens the "choose a promo" menu above the promo button. Menu items apply a promo on click;
/// a "Clear applied promo" item appears when one is currently applied. The button's label is
/// refreshed from RefreshPromoButton() after any change, so the button always reflects state.
/// </summary>
private void ShowPromoMenu()
{
    if (_transactionViewModel is null)
        return;

    var menu = new ContextMenuStrip();

    if (_transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems.Count > 0)
    {
        var clear = menu.Items.Add("Clear applied promo");
        clear.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9f);
        clear.Click += (s, e) =>
        {
            _transactionViewModel.ClearPromos();
            RefreshPromoButton();
        };
        menu.Items.Add(new ToolStripSeparator());
    }

    if (_transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos.Count == 0)
    {
        var none = menu.Items.Add("No promos available for this order");
        none.Enabled = false;
    }
    else
    {
        foreach (var campaign in _transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos)
        {
            var alreadyApplied = _transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems
                .Any(r => r.CampaignId == campaign.CampaignId);

            var label = campaign.DiscountType == "Percentage"
                ? $"{campaign.PromoName} — {campaign.DiscountValue:0.##}% off"
                : $"{campaign.PromoName} — ₱{campaign.DiscountValue:0.##} off";
            if (alreadyApplied)
                label += "  (applied)";

            var item = menu.Items.Add(label);
            item.Enabled = !alreadyApplied;
            item.Click += (s, e) =>
            {
                _transactionViewModel.ApplyPromoCommand.Execute(campaign);
                RefreshPromoButton();
            };
        }
    }

    menu.Show(_promoMenuBtn, new Point(0, -menu.PreferredSize.Height));
}
```

Note: the menu is shown *above* the button (`new Point(0, -menu.PreferredSize.Height)`) because the button is at the bottom of the column — dropping it *down* would fall off the window.

**Replace `RefreshPromoCombo()`** with a much simpler `RefreshPromoButton()`:

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Syncs the promo button's label with the currently-applied promo (if any) and enables/
/// disables it based on whether there's an active transaction. Called from RefreshSummary
/// (which is the one place all cart-state changes funnel through) and from ShowPromoMenu
/// after apply/clear so the label updates immediately.
/// </summary>
private void RefreshPromoButton()
{
    if (_transactionViewModel is null)
    {
        _promoMenuBtn.Text = "Select a Promo ▾";
        _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = false;
        return;
    }

    var applied = _transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems.FirstOrDefault();

    if (applied is null)
    {
        _promoMenuBtn.Text = "Select a Promo ▾";
    }
    else
    {
        // Look up the campaign's display name from the eligible list first; if it's since
        // become ineligible, fall back to the campaign service so the label still reads right.
        var campaign = _transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos
                           .FirstOrDefault(c => c.CampaignId == applied.CampaignId)
                       ?? ServiceRegistry.Campaigns.GetById(applied.CampaignId);

        var name = campaign?.PromoName ?? $"Promo #{applied.CampaignId}";
        _promoMenuBtn.Text = $"{name} ▾";
    }

    _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = true;
}
```

**In `RefreshSummary()`**, replace the `RefreshPromoCombo();` call with `RefreshPromoButton();`:

```csharp
private void RefreshSummary()
{
    RefreshPromoButton();

    if (_transactionViewModel is null)
    {
        // ... unchanged ...
    }
    // ... unchanged ...
}
```

**That's the whole change.** No `_suppressPromoApply` needed anymore (there's no ComboBox whose programmatic selection could re-fire events). No `PromoItem` needed anymore either — the menu items carry the campaign in their closure directly. **You can delete the `PromoItem` record from the class**, and delete `_suppressPromoApply`.

```csharp
using System.ComponentModel;
using CRM_Morcaffein.domain.entities;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views.Controls
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The Transactions/POS tab. A left column identifies the customer by ID or contact
    /// number only (a single search box, not a browsable directory), a middle area lists
    /// drink cards with a category filter, and a right column holds the running Order and
    /// the Payables/checkout summary with its own "Log Sale" button — scoped to that
    /// column's width, not the whole screen. Picking a customer is what starts the
    /// transaction (an Order always needs a real Customer under the hood, see
    /// TransactionViewModel), but nothing blocks the rest of the screen while you search.
    /// </summary>
    public class TransactionView : UserControl
    {
        private readonly ICustomerService _customerService;
        private readonly IOrderService _orderService;
        private readonly IProductCatalogService _catalogService;

        private TransactionViewModel? _transactionViewModel;

        }

        public TransactionView(ICustomerService customerService, IOrderService orderService, IProductCatalogService catalogService)

        // =====================================================================
        // LAYOUT CONSTRUCTION

        private void BuildLayout()
        {
            Dock = DockStyle.Fill;

            var tableCardPanel = new Panel
            {

            {
                if (_transactionViewModel is null || _categoryCombo.SelectedItem is not string category) return;
                _transactionViewModel.SelectedCategory = category == AllCategoriesOption ? string.Empty : category;
            };

            // Measure both labels explicitly — AutoSize labels report Right=0 until parented,
            // which is why the previous offset-based positioning collapsed the gap. Both Left
            // values are computed from measured widths, so the combo can never overlap the label.
            var drinksWidth = TextRenderer.MeasureText(drinksLabel.Text, drinksLabel.Font).Width;
            var sortLabelWidth = TextRenderer.MeasureText(sortLabel.Text, sortLabel.Font).Width;

            drinksLabel.Left = 0;
            drinksLabel.Top = 0;

            sortLabel.Left = drinksWidth + 24;
            sortLabel.Top = (sortRow.Height - sortLabel.Height) / 2 + 2;

            _categoryCombo.Left = drinksWidth + 24 + sortLabelWidth + 14;
            _categoryCombo.Top = (sortRow.Height - _categoryCombo.Height) / 2;

            sortRow.Controls.Add(drinksLabel);
            sortRow.Controls.Add(sortLabel);
            sortRow.Controls.Add(_categoryCombo);

            var divider = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Bottom, Height = 1, BackColor = BrandPalette.Border };

            header.Controls.Add(sortRow);
            header.Controls.Add(searchRow);
            header.Controls.Add(divider);

            _productsFlowPanel = new FlowLayoutPanel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                FlowDirection = FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
                WrapContents = true,
                AutoScroll = true,
                Padding = new Padding(12),
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
            };

            area.Controls.Add(_productsFlowPanel);
            area.Controls.Add(header);

            return area;
        }

        private Panel BuildOrderColumn()
        {
            // Padding on the column itself insets ALL three child boxes (Order, Payables, Log Sale)
            // uniformly from the card's edges.
            var column = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Right,
                Width = 380,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
                Padding = new Padding(10, 10, 10, 10),
            };

            var orderBox = BuildOrderBox();
            var payablesBox = BuildPayablesBox();
            var logSaleBox = BuildLogSaleBox();

            column.Controls.Add(orderBox);
            column.Controls.Add(payablesBox);
            column.Controls.Add(logSaleBox);

            return column;
        }

        private Panel BuildLogSaleBox()
        {
            var box = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 56,
                Margin = new Padding(10, 0, 10, 10),
                Padding = new Padding(10),
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
            };

            _logSaleBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Log Sale",
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(10.5f),
                Enabled = false,
            };
            _logSaleBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            _logSaleBtn.Click += (s, e) => _transactionViewModel?.CompleteSaleCommand.Execute(null);
            ButtonStyler.TrackEnabledState(_logSaleBtn);

            box.Controls.Add(_logSaleBtn);
            return box;
        }

        private Panel BuildOrderBox()
        {
            var box = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                Margin = new Padding(0, 0, 0, 10),   // gap to Payables below; outer inset comes from the column's Padding
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
            };

            var header = new Label
            {
                Text = "Order",
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 28,
                Padding = new Padding(10, 6, 0, 0),
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(10f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText,
            };
            var divider = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 1, BackColor = BrandPalette.Border };

            _cartLinesPanel = new FlowLayoutPanel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                FlowDirection = FlowDirection.TopDown,
                WrapContents = false,
                AutoScroll = true,
                Padding = new Padding(8, 6, 8, 6),
            };

            _cartEmptyLabel = new Label
            {
                Text = "No items yet.\nTap a drink to add it.",
                Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
                TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
            };
            _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Add(_cartEmptyLabel);

            box.Controls.Add(_cartLinesPanel);
            box.Controls.Add(divider);
            box.Controls.Add(header);

            return box;
        }

        private Panel BuildPayablesBox()
        {
            var box = new Panel
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Bottom,
                Height = 254,
                Margin = new Padding(10, 0, 10, 10),
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
                Padding = new Padding(14, 12, 14, 12),
            };

            var header = new Label
            {
                Text = "Payables",
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 24,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText,
            };

            _cartStatusLabel = new Label
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 20,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill,
            };

            var summaryTable = new TableLayoutPanel { Dock = DockStyle.Fill, ColumnCount = 2, RowCount = 5 };
            summaryTable.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent, 55f));
            summaryTable.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent, 45f));

            Label MakeCaption(string text) => new() { Text = text, Dock = DockStyle.Fill, Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f), ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted, TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft };
            Label MakeValue() => new() { Text = "₱0.00", Dock = DockStyle.Fill, Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11f), ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText, TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleRight };

            _subTotalValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _discountValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _vatValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _pwdSeniorValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _totalValueLabel = MakeValue();
            _totalValueLabel.ForeColor = BrandPalette.Brand;
            _totalValueLabel.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(15f);

            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("Subtotal"), 0, 0);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_subTotalValueLabel, 1, 0);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("Discount"), 0, 1);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_discountValueLabel, 1, 1);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("VAT (12%)"), 0, 2);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_vatValueLabel, 1, 2);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("PWD/Senior Disc."), 0, 3);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_pwdSeniorValueLabel, 1, 3);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(MakeCaption("Total"), 0, 4);
            summaryTable.Controls.Add(_totalValueLabel, 1, 4);

            box.Controls.Add(summaryTable);
            box.Controls.Add(_cartStatusLabel);
            box.Controls.Add(header);

            return box;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // CUSTOMER SELECTION
        // =====================================================================

        private void RunCustomerSearch()
        {
            var query = _customerSearchTxtBx.Text.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query))
                return;

            var match = _customerService.FindByPhoneOrId(query);
            if (match is null)
            {
                _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = $"No customer found for \"{query}\".";
                _customerProfilePanel.Visible = false;
                return;
            }

            _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = string.Empty;
            ShowCustomerProfile(match);
            SelectCustomer(match);
        }

        private void ShowCustomerProfile(Customer customer)
        {
            _customerProfileNameLabel.Text = customer.FullName;
            _customerProfileDetailLabel.Text = $"{customer.Tier} Tier   •   {customer.PointsBalance} pts\n{customer.ContactNumber}";
            _customerProfilePanel.Visible = true;
        }

        private void SelectCustomer(Customer customer)
        {
            var employeeId = EmployeeSession.Current?.EmployeeId
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No employee session — the Transaction view requires a logged-in employee.");

            // Search-and-Go = start a fresh transaction. If the existing cart has items, confirm
            // first — a staff member mid-sale who mistypes a customer ID shouldn't lose their work
            // silently. Empty carts (or no VM yet) just get replaced without asking.
            if (_transactionViewModel is not null && _transactionViewModel.CartItems.Count > 0)
            {
                var currentCustomerName = _transactionViewModel.Customer.FullName;
                var confirm = MessageBox.Show(
                    FindForm(),
                    $"Discard the in-progress order for {currentCustomerName} and start a new one for {customer.FullName}?",
                    "Start New Transaction",
                    MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);

                if (confirm != DialogResult.Yes)
                {
                    _customerSearchTxtBx.Text = _transactionViewModel.Customer.CustomerId.ToString();
                    return;
                }
            }

            _transactionViewModel = new TransactionViewModel(_orderService, _catalogService, ServiceRegistry.Campaigns, customer, employeeId);
            _transactionViewModel.SaleCompleted += (s, e) => OnSaleCompleted();
            _transactionViewModel.OperationFailed += (s, message) => ShowCartStatus(message);
            _transactionViewModel.PropertyChanged += TransactionViewModel_PropertyChanged;
            _transactionViewModel.VisibleProducts.ListChanged += (s, e) => RefreshProductsPanel();
            _transactionViewModel.CartItems.ListChanged += (s, e) => RefreshCartLines();

            RefreshProductsPanel();
            RefreshCartLines();
            RefreshSummary();
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // DRINKS / CART / CHECKOUT
        // =====================================================================

        private void TransactionViewModel_PropertyChanged(object? sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.PropertyName is nameof(TransactionViewModel.SubTotal) or nameof(TransactionViewModel.TotalDiscount) or nameof(TransactionViewModel.TotalAmount))
                RefreshSummary();

            if (e.PropertyName == nameof(TransactionViewModel.Customer))
                ShowCustomerProfile(_transactionViewModel!.Customer);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Opens the "choose a promo" menu above the promo button. Menu items apply a promo on
        /// click; a "Clear applied promo" item appears when one is currently applied. The button
        /// label is refreshed from RefreshPromoButton() after any change, so the button always
        /// reflects the current state.
        /// </summary>
        private void ShowPromoMenu()
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
                return;

            var menu = new ContextMenuStrip();

            if (_transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems.Count > 0)
            {
                var clear = menu.Items.Add("Clear applied promo");
                clear.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9f);
                clear.Click += (s, e) =>
                {
                    _transactionViewModel.ClearPromos();
                    RefreshPromoButton();
                };
                menu.Items.Add(new ToolStripSeparator());
            }

            if (_transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos.Count == 0)
            {
                var none = menu.Items.Add("No promos available for this order");
                none.Enabled = false;
            }
            else
            {
                foreach (var campaign in _transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos)
                {
                    var alreadyApplied = _transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems
                        .Any(r => r.CampaignId == campaign.CampaignId);

                    var label = campaign.DiscountType == "Percentage"
                        ? $"{campaign.PromoName} — {campaign.DiscountValue:0.##}% off"
                        : $"{campaign.PromoName} — ₱{campaign.DiscountValue:0.##} off";
                    if (alreadyApplied)
                        label += "  (applied)";

                    var item = menu.Items.Add(label);
                    item.Enabled = !alreadyApplied;
                    item.Click += (s, e) =>
                    {
                        _transactionViewModel.ApplyPromoCommand.Execute(campaign);
                        RefreshPromoButton();
                    };
                }
            }

            // The button sits at the bottom of the column, so the menu opens above it — dropping
            // it downward would fall off the window.
            menu.Show(_promoMenuBtn, new Point(0, -menu.PreferredSize.Height));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Syncs the promo button's label with the currently-applied promo (if any) and
        /// enables/disables it based on whether there's an active transaction. Called from
        /// RefreshSummary (the funnel for all cart-state changes) and from ShowPromoMenu after
        /// apply/clear so the label updates immediately.
        /// </summary>
        private void RefreshPromoButton()
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                _promoMenuBtn.Text = "Select a Promo ▾";
                _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            var applied = _transactionViewModel.Order.CampaignRedeems.FirstOrDefault();

            if (applied is null)
            {
                _promoMenuBtn.Text = "Select a Promo ▾";
            }
            else
            {
                // Look up the campaign's display name from the eligible list first; if it's
                // since become ineligible, fall back to the campaign service so the label
                // still reads right.
                var campaign = _transactionViewModel.EligiblePromos
                                   .FirstOrDefault(c => c.CampaignId == applied.CampaignId)
                               ?? ServiceRegistry.Campaigns.GetById(applied.CampaignId);

                var name = campaign?.PromoName ?? $"Promo #{applied.CampaignId}";
                _promoMenuBtn.Text = $"{name} ▾";
            }

            _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = true;
        }

        private void RefreshSummary()
        {
            RefreshPromoButton();

            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                _subTotalValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _discountValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _vatValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _pwdSeniorValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _totalValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _logSaleBtn.Enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            _subTotalValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.SubTotal:0.00}";
            _discountValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.TotalDiscount:0.00}";
            _vatValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.TotalAmount * VatRate:0.00}";
            _pwdSeniorValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
            _totalValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_transactionViewModel.TotalAmount:0.00}";
            _logSaleBtn.Enabled = _transactionViewModel.CompleteSaleCommand.CanExecute(null);
        }

        private void BuildCategoryOptions()
        {
            _categoryCombo.Items.Clear();
            _categoryCombo.Items.Add(AllCategoriesOption);
            foreach (var category in _catalogService.GetCategories())
                _categoryCombo.Items.Add(category);
            _categoryCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        private void RefreshProductsPanel()
        {
            _productsFlowPanel.Controls.Clear();
            if (_transactionViewModel is null) return;

            foreach (var product in _transactionViewModel.VisibleProducts)
            {
                var card = new ProductCardControl(product);
                card.CardClicked += (s, e) => OpenCustomizerForNewItem(product);
                card.SizeQuickAdded += (s, size) => QuickAddToCart(product, size);
                _productsFlowPanel.Controls.Add(card);
            }
        }

        private void QuickAddToCart(Product product, ProductSize size)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                ShowCartStatus("Pick a customer on the left first.");
                return;
            }

            _transactionViewModel.AddItemToCart(product, size, 1, Enumerable.Empty<ProductModifier>());
        }

        private void OpenCustomizerForNewItem(Product product)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null)
            {
                ShowCartStatus("Pick a customer on the left first.");
                return;
            }

            var customizerViewModel = new ItemCustomizerViewModel(product, _catalogService.GetModifiers());
            using var form = new FrmItemCustomizer(customizerViewModel);

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                _transactionViewModel.AddItemToCart(product, customizerViewModel.SelectedSize, customizerViewModel.Quantity, customizerViewModel.SelectedModifiers);
            }
        }

        private void OpenCustomizerForEdit(OrderItem item)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null || item.Product is null) return;

            var customizerViewModel = new ItemCustomizerViewModel(item.Product, _catalogService.GetModifiers(), item);
            using var form = new FrmItemCustomizer(customizerViewModel);

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                _transactionViewModel.UpdateCartItem(item, customizerViewModel.SelectedSize, customizerViewModel.Quantity, customizerViewModel.SelectedModifiers);
            }
        }

        private void RefreshCartLines()
        {
            _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Clear();

            if (_transactionViewModel is null || _transactionViewModel.CartItems.Count == 0)
            {
                _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Add(_cartEmptyLabel);
                return;
            }

            var lineWidth = Math.Max(200,
                _cartLinesPanel.ClientSize.Width - SystemInformation.VerticalScrollBarWidth - 8);

            foreach (var item in _transactionViewModel.CartItems)
            {
                var line = new CartLineControl(item) { Width = lineWidth };
                line.QuantityIncreased += (s, e) => ChangeQuantity(item, +1);
                line.QuantityDecreased += (s, e) => ChangeQuantity(item, -1);
                line.RemoveClicked += (s, e) => _transactionViewModel!.RemoveItemCommand.Execute(item);
                _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Add(line);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// The Order box's inline "-"/"+" stepper. TransactionViewModel has no dedicated
        /// "just change the quantity" method — UpdateCartItem needs the real ProductSize and
        /// ProductModifier domain objects, not just the OrderItem's snapshotted values, so
        /// they're looked back up from the catalog here. Dropping to 0 removes the line.
        /// </summary>
        private void ChangeQuantity(OrderItem item, int delta)
        {
            if (_transactionViewModel is null || item.Product is null) return;

            var newQuantity = item.Quantity + delta;
            if (newQuantity <= 0)
            {
                _transactionViewModel.RemoveItemCommand.Execute(item);
                return;
            }

            var size = item.Product.ProductSizes.First(s => s.ProductSizeId == item.ProductSizeId);
            var modifiers = _catalogService.GetModifiers()
                .Where(m => item.OrderItemModifiers.Any(om => om.ProductModifierId == m.ProductModifierId));

            _transactionViewModel.UpdateCartItem(item, size, newQuantity, modifiers);
        }

        private void ShowCartStatus(string message) => _cartStatusLabel.Text = message;

        private void OnSaleCompleted()
        {
            var vm = _transactionViewModel!;
            MessageBox.Show(FindForm(),
                $"Sale completed. {vm.Order.PointsEarned} points awarded to {vm.Customer.FullName}.",
                "Sale Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

            _transactionViewModel = null;
            _customerProfilePanel.Visible = false;
            _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = string.Empty;
            _customerSearchTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
            RefreshProductsPanel();
            RefreshCartLines();
            RefreshSummary();
        }
    }
}
```

**What's changed vs. your last version:**

- Left column `Width 220 → 260`
- `_promoCombo`, `_suppressPromoApply`, and the `PromoItem` record are gone
- Promo row is now a single full-width `_promoMenuBtn`
- `ShowPromoMenu()` rewritten: menu opens above the button, applies on click, "Clear applied promo" at the top when something's active
- `RefreshPromoCombo()` replaced with `RefreshPromoButton()` — syncs the button label to the applied promo
- `RefreshSummary()` calls `RefreshPromoButton()` instead of `RefreshPromoCombo()`

Paste the whole thing over `TransactionView.cs` and rebuild. The `CartLineControl.cs` `Margin = new Padding(0)` fix from before is still separate — if you haven't applied it, do that too or the `+` will still be squeezed.

## 2. Point adjustment — support negatives

Good news: **it already does.** The full chain supports negative adjustments today:

- `PointAdjustmentRequest` constructor accepts any non-zero `pointsChange` (no positivity check)
- `Customer.AdjustPoints(int pointsChange, ...)` handles negative (it's `PointsBalance + pointsChange`, throws only if the result would go negative)
- `CustomerProfileViewModel.RequestAmount` is an `int`, bound to a `NumericUpDown` with `Minimum = -100000`
- `MockPointAdjustmentService.RequestAdjustment` passes it through unchanged

So the domain and viewmodel already support it. **What I want to verify** is whether the UI actually lets a staff member enter a negative number. Your screenshot earlier showed the request panel with `0` in the NumericUpDown — which suggests the value is editable, but I want to confirm the `Minimum` is negative (it is — I see it in the Designer I read earlier: `requestAmountNud.Minimum = -100000;`).

**If it's already working, nothing to change.** If you've tried entering a negative and it got clamped to 0, that'd mean something is overriding `Minimum` at runtime — but I don't see any such override in the code I read.

**Can you confirm:** is a negative amount already enterable in the request panel? If yes, this item is a no-op. If no, tell me what happens when you try and I'll diagnose.

**One thing I'd add regardless:** a small label or hint near the NUD saying "negative to deduct" so staff know negatives are allowed. That's cosmetic. Do you want it?

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.Common;
using CRM_Morcaffein.domain.entities;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.ViewModels
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Read-only detail holder for the Feedback drawer — the currently-selected ticket's
    /// display data. This app is the staff console: staff log feedback and view its status,
    /// but resolving/dismissing/awarding is a manager decision that happens on a different
    /// surface, so there are no commands or decision state here.
    /// </summary>
    public class FeedbackDetailViewModel : ObservableObject
    {
        public Feedback Ticket { get; }

        public FeedbackDetailViewModel(Feedback ticket)
        {
            Ticket = ticket;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        private static void ConfigureGrid(DataGridView grid, float headerSize, int rowHeight)
        {
            grid.BackgroundColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            grid.AllowUserToAddRows = false;
            grid.AllowUserToDeleteRows = false;
            grid.AllowUserToResizeRows = false;
            grid.ReadOnly = true;
            grid.RowHeadersVisible = false;
            grid.MultiSelect = false;
            grid.SelectionMode = DataGridViewSelectionMode.FullRowSelect;
            grid.AutoGenerateColumns = false;
            grid.EnableHeadersVisualStyles = false;
            grid.GridColor = BrandPalette.Border;
            grid.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(headerSize);
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.BackColor = BrandPalette.HeaderBackground;
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = BrandPalette.HeaderText;
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(headerSize);
            // Clicking a header to sort selects that header cell — without this, WinForms
            // paints that selection using the system Highlight color (blue) regardless of
            // the rest of the theme.
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = BrandPalette.HeaderBackground;
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = BrandPalette.HeaderText;
            grid.ColumnHeadersHeight = rowHeight + 6;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = BrandPalette.RowSelected;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText;
            grid.RowTemplate.Height = rowHeight;
            grid.ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical;
        }
    }
}
```

## 3. `FeedbackManagementView.cs`

Decision wiring and the three resolve/dismiss methods gone. `ICampaignService` dropped from the constructors. `RefreshDrawer()` is now purely display.

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.domain.entities;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Services;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Session;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Theme;
using CRM_Morcaffein.ViewModels;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views.Controls
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The Feedback tab: a boxed table (search top-left, "+ Log Feedback" top-right, same
    /// layout as the Customers tab) listing every ticket ever logged, and a left-side
    /// drawer showing full ticket detail for whichever ticket is selected.
    ///
    /// This is the staff console — staff log feedback and view its status. Resolving,
    /// dismissing, or awarding bonus points is a manager decision that belongs on a
    /// different surface, so no decision UI lives here.
    /// </summary>
    public partial class FeedbackManagementView : UserControl
    {
        private readonly ICustomerService _customerService;
        private readonly IFeedbackService _feedbackService;
        private readonly FeedbackViewModel _viewModel;
        private readonly BindingSource _ticketsBindingSource = new();

        private FeedbackDetailViewModel? _detailViewModel;

        public FeedbackManagementView()
            : this(ServiceRegistry.Customers, ServiceRegistry.Feedback)
        {
        }

        public FeedbackManagementView(ICustomerService customerService, IFeedbackService feedbackService)
        {
            _customerService = customerService;
            _feedbackService = feedbackService;
            InitializeComponent();

            ConfigureTicketsGridColumns();

            _viewModel = new FeedbackViewModel(_feedbackService);
            _viewModel.LogFeedbackRequested += (s, e) => OpenLogFeedbackModal();

            _ticketsBindingSource.DataSource = _viewModel.Tickets;
            ticketsGrid.DataSource = _ticketsBindingSource;
            ticketsGrid.SelectionChanged += TicketsGrid_SelectionChanged;
            ticketsGrid.CellFormatting += TicketsGrid_CellFormatting;

            searchTxtBx.TextChanged += (s, e) => _viewModel.SearchText = searchTxtBx.Text;
            logFeedbackBtn.Click += (s, e) => _viewModel.LogFeedbackCommand.Execute(null);

            // logFeedbackBtn hugs the card's right edge — see the identical note in
            // CustomerManagementView.PositionActionButton for why this isn't done via Anchor.
            cardHeaderPanel.Resize += (s, e) => PositionActionButton();
            PositionActionButton();

            RefreshDrawer();
        }

        private void PositionActionButton()
        {
            logFeedbackBtn.Left = cardHeaderPanel.ClientSize.Width - logFeedbackBtn.Width - 16;
            logFeedbackBtn.Top = 14;
        }

        private void TicketsGrid_SelectionChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _viewModel.SelectedTicket = ticketsGrid.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem as Feedback;
            RefreshDrawer();
        }

        private void TicketsGrid_CellFormatting(object? sender, DataGridViewCellFormattingEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ticketsGrid.Rows[e.RowIndex].DataBoundItem is not Feedback ticket)
                return;

            var columnName = ticketsGrid.Columns[e.ColumnIndex].Name;
            if (columnName == "CustomerName")
            {
                e.Value = ticket.Customer?.FullName ?? "—";
                e.FormattingApplied = true;
            }
            else if (columnName == "RatingDisplay")
            {
                e.Value = $"{ticket.Rating}/5";
                e.FormattingApplied = true;
            }
        }

        private void OpenLogFeedbackModal()
        {
            var logViewModel = new LogFeedbackViewModel(_feedbackService, _customerService, EmployeeSession.Current!.EmployeeId);
            using var form = new FrmLogFeedback(logViewModel);

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK && logViewModel.CreatedFeedback != null)
            {
                _viewModel.OnFeedbackLogged(logViewModel.CreatedFeedback);
                RefreshDrawer();
                SelectTicketRowById(logViewModel.CreatedFeedback.TicketId);
            }
        }

        private void RefreshDrawer()
        {
            var ticket = _viewModel.SelectedTicket;
            if (ticket is null)
            {
                drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = true;
                drawerContentPanel.Visible = false;
                _detailViewModel = null;
                return;
            }

            drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = false;
            drawerContentPanel.Visible = true;

            _detailViewModel = new FeedbackDetailViewModel(ticket);

            ticketCustomerLabel.Text = ticket.Customer?.FullName ?? "—";
            ticketRatingLabel.Text = new string('★', ticket.Rating) + new string('☆', 5 - ticket.Rating);
            ticketCategoryLabel.Text = $"Category: {ticket.Category}";
            ticketStatusLabel.Text = $"Status: {ticket.Status}";
            ticketDateLabel.Text = $"Logged {ticket.DateLogged:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} by {ticket.LoggedByEmployee?.FullName ?? "—"}";
            ticketNotesLabel.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ticket.StaffNotes) ? "(no notes)" : ticket.StaffNotes;
        }

        private void SelectTicketRowById(int ticketId)
        {
            foreach (DataGridViewRow row in ticketsGrid.Rows)
            {
                if (row.DataBoundItem is Feedback f && f.TicketId == ticketId)
                {
                    ticketsGrid.ClearSelection();
                    row.Selected = true;
                    ticketsGrid.CurrentCell = row.Cells[0];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        private void ConfigureTicketsGridColumns()
        {
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Clear();
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.TicketId),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.TicketId),
                HeaderText = "Ticket #",
                Width = 70,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = "CustomerName", // unbound — Customer is a nav property, populated via CellFormatting
                HeaderText = "Customer",
                Width = 160,
                AutoSizeMode = DataGridViewAutoSizeColumnMode.Fill,
                SortMode = DataGridViewColumnSortMode.NotSortable,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = "RatingDisplay", // unbound — via CellFormatting
                HeaderText = "Rating",
                Width = 60,
                SortMode = DataGridViewColumnSortMode.NotSortable,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.Category),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.Category),
                HeaderText = "Category",
                Width = 90,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.Status),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.Status),
                HeaderText = "Status",
                Width = 90,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.DateLogged),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.DateLogged),
                HeaderText = "Logged",
                Width = 130,
                DefaultCellStyle = new DataGridViewCellStyle { Format = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" },
            });
        }
    }
}
```

Note: this file uses `System.ComponentModel.BindingSource`, but the original didn't have `using System.ComponentModel;` at the top — it worked before because the compiler found it via the fully-qualified `BindingSource` in a different scope. I left it as-is, matching the original.
