```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers;
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Session;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Theme;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views.Controls
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The Customers tab. Searchable grid + profile drawer. Point-adjustment UI is
    /// gated by EmployeeSession role — the API enforces the same rules server-side.
    /// </summary>
    public partial class CustomerManagementView : UserControl
    {
        private readonly CustomerController _controller;
        private readonly BindingSource _customersBindingSource = new();

        private CustomerResponseDto? _selectedCustomer;
        private PointAdjustmentResponseDto? _selectedRequest;

        public CustomerManagementView()
        {
            _controller = new CustomerController();
            InitializeComponent();

            ConfigureCustomersGridColumns();
            ConfigureOrderHistoryGridColumns();
            ConfigureLedgerGridColumns();
            ConfigureAdjustmentRequestsGridColumns();

            customersGrid.DataSource = _customersBindingSource;
            customersGrid.SelectionChanged += CustomersGrid_SelectionChanged;

            searchTxtBx.TextChanged += (s, e) => ReloadCustomers();
            newCustomerBtn.Click += (s, e) => OpenOnboardingModal();

            cardHeaderPanel.Resize += (s, e) => PositionActionButton();
            PositionActionButton();

            ButtonStyler.TrackEnabledState(submitRequestBtn);
            ButtonStyler.TrackEnabledState(approveBtn);
            ButtonStyler.TrackEnabledState(rejectBtn);

            adjustmentRequestsGrid.SelectionChanged += AdjustmentRequestsGrid_SelectionChanged;

            requestAmountNud.ValueChanged += (s, e) => UpdateSubmitRequestEnabled();
            requestReasonTxtBx.TextChanged += (s, e) => UpdateSubmitRequestEnabled();
            submitRequestBtn.Click += SubmitRequestBtn_Click;

            rejectionNotesTxtBx.TextChanged += (s, e) => UpdateApprovalControlsEnabled();
            approveBtn.Click += ApproveBtn_Click;
            rejectBtn.Click += RejectBtn_Click;

            Load += async (s, e) => await ReloadCustomersAsync();
        }

        private bool CanRequestAdjustment => IsManager(EmployeeSession.Current?.Employee?.Role);
        private bool CanApprove => IsAdmin(EmployeeSession.Current?.Employee?.Role);

        private static bool IsManager(string? role) =>
            role != null && (
                role.Equals("Manager", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                role.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                role.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        private static bool IsAdmin(string? role) =>
            role != null && (
                role.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                role.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        private void PositionActionButton()
        {
            newCustomerBtn.Left = cardHeaderPanel.ClientSize.Width - newCustomerBtn.Width - 16;
            newCustomerBtn.Top = 14;
        }

        private async Task ReloadCustomersAsync()
        {
            var previousId = _selectedCustomer?.CustomerId;
            var results = await _controller.SearchAsync(searchTxtBx.Text);
            _customersBindingSource.DataSource = results;

            var stillPresent = previousId.HasValue
                ? results.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CustomerId == previousId.Value)
                : null;

            if (stillPresent != null)
                SelectCustomerRowById(stillPresent.CustomerId);
            else
            {
                _selectedCustomer = null;
                await RefreshDrawerAsync();
            }
        }

        private async void ReloadCustomers()
        {
            try { await ReloadCustomersAsync(); }
            catch (Exception ex) { MessageBox.Show(FindForm(), ex.Message, "Error"); }
        }

        private async void CustomersGrid_SelectionChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _selectedCustomer = customersGrid.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem as CustomerResponseDto;
            await RefreshDrawerAsync();
        }

        private void AdjustmentRequestsGrid_SelectionChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _selectedRequest = adjustmentRequestsGrid.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem as PointAdjustmentResponseDto;
            UpdateApprovalControlsEnabled();
        }

        private void UpdateSubmitRequestEnabled()
        {
            submitRequestBtn.Enabled = CanRequestAdjustment &&
                requestAmountNud.Value != 0 &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestReasonTxtBx.Text);
        }

        private void UpdateApprovalControlsEnabled()
        {
            approvalHintLabel.Text = _selectedRequest is { Status: "Pending" }
                ? $"Selected: {(_selectedRequest.PointsChange > 0 ? "+" : string.Empty)}{_selectedRequest.PointsChange} pts — {_selectedRequest.Reason}"
                : "Select a pending request above.";

            var canActOnSelection = CanApprove &&
                _selectedRequest is { Status: "Pending" } &&
                _selectedRequest.RequestedBy != EmployeeSession.Current?.EmployeeId;

            approveBtn.Enabled = canActOnSelection;
            rejectBtn.Enabled = canActOnSelection && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rejectionNotesTxtBx.Text);
        }

        private async void SubmitRequestBtn_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (_selectedCustomer is null) return;

            try
            {
                await _controller.RequestAdjustmentAsync(
                    _selectedCustomer.CustomerId, (int)requestAmountNud.Value,
                    requestReasonTxtBx.Text, EmployeeSession.Current!.EmployeeId);

                requestStatusLabel.Text = "Submitted — waiting on admin approval.";
                requestAmountNud.Value = 0;
                requestReasonTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
                await RefreshDrawerAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                requestStatusLabel.Text = ex.Message;
            }
        }

        private async void ApproveBtn_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (_selectedRequest is null || _selectedCustomer is null) return;

            try
            {
                await _controller.ApproveAdjustmentAsync(
                    _selectedRequest.PointAdjustmentRequestId,
                    EmployeeSession.Current!.EmployeeId);

                approvalStatusLabel.Text = "Approved — points applied.";
                rejectionNotesTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;

                var affectedCustomerId = _selectedCustomer.CustomerId;
                await ReloadCustomersAsync();
                SelectCustomerRowById(affectedCustomerId);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                approvalStatusLabel.Text = ex.Message;
            }
        }

        private async void RejectBtn_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (_selectedRequest is null) return;

            try
            {
                await _controller.RejectAdjustmentAsync(
                    _selectedRequest.PointAdjustmentRequestId,
                    EmployeeSession.Current!.EmployeeId,
                    rejectionNotesTxtBx.Text);

                approvalStatusLabel.Text = "Rejected.";
                rejectionNotesTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
                await RefreshDrawerAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                approvalStatusLabel.Text = ex.Message;
            }
        }

        private async void OpenOnboardingModal()
        {
            using var form = new FrmCustomerOnboarding(_controller);

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK && form.CreatedCustomer != null)
            {
                await ReloadCustomersAsync();
                SelectCustomerRowById(form.CreatedCustomer.CustomerId);
            }
        }

        private async Task RefreshDrawerAsync()
        {
            var customer = _selectedCustomer;
            if (customer is null)
            {
                drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = true;
                drawerContentPanel.Visible = false;
                return;
            }

            drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = false;
            drawerContentPanel.Visible = true;

            customerNameLabel.Text = customer.FullName;
            tierBadgeLabel.Text = $"{customer.Tier} Tier";
            pointsBalanceLabel.Text = $"{customer.PointsBalance:N0} pts";
            contactLabel.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(customer.Email)
                ? customer.ContactNumber
                : $"{customer.ContactNumber}   •   {customer.Email}";

            try
            {
                var orders = await _controller.GetOrderHistoryAsync(customer.CustomerId);
                orderHistoryGrid.DataSource = null;
                orderHistoryGrid.DataSource = orders;

                var ledger = await _controller.GetLedgerAsync(customer.CustomerId);
                ledgerGrid.DataSource = null;
                ledgerGrid.DataSource = ledger;

                var pending = await _controller.GetPendingAdjustmentsAsync(customer.CustomerId);
                _selectedRequest = null;
                adjustmentRequestsGrid.DataSource = null;
                adjustmentRequestsGrid.DataSource = pending;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(FindForm(), ex.Message, "Error loading drawer");
            }

            requestSectionPanel.Visible = CanRequestAdjustment;
            approvalSectionPanel.Visible = CanApprove;

            requestAmountNud.Value = 0;
            requestReasonTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
            requestStatusLabel.Text = string.Empty;
            UpdateSubmitRequestEnabled();

            rejectionNotesTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
            approvalStatusLabel.Text = string.Empty;
            approvalHintLabel.Text = "Select a pending request above.";
            approveBtn.Enabled = false;
            rejectBtn.Enabled = false;
        }

        private void SelectCustomerRowById(int customerId)
        {
            foreach (DataGridViewRow row in customersGrid.Rows)
            {

                {
                    customersGrid.ClearSelection();
                    row.Selected = true;
                    customersGrid.CurrentCell = row.Cells[0];
                    _selectedCustomer = c;
                    _ = RefreshDrawerAsync();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
```

## Where we are

**Batch A (API side)**: done, built clean.

**Batch B (WinForms side)**:

- Files 1–3 (ApiConfig, CustomerApi, PointAdjustmentApi): **you've pasted them**

**The problem I tripped over:** `TransactionController` takes a `Customer` **entity** in its constructor, but the customer search now returns a `CustomerResponseDto`. So `TransactionView` needs to convert.

**This is a real design question I should have raised before writing file 7, not fumbled through at the end of file 7.**

---

## The actual decision to make

Two ways to bridge:

**Option A — Convert DTO → entity in the View.** Construct a `new Customer { ... }` from the DTO before passing to `TransactionController`. Works. Slightly ugly (the View knows about both types). But contained, small.

**Option B — Change `TransactionController` to take a `CustomerResponseDto`.** But `TransactionController` is deeply coupled to the `Customer` entity — it uses `Customer.PointLedgers.Add(...)`, `Customer.PointsBalance`, `Customer.Birthday`, `Customer.LastVisitDate`. Those are all on the entity, and the DTO has some but not all of them. So this would require more changes.

**Option C — Defer.** Since `TransactionController` is entirely mock-backed (it uses `IOrderService`, `IProductCatalogService`, `ICampaignService` — all still mocks) until we migrate Orders, maybe leave its customer coupling alone and just do the minimum: convert DTO→entity in one place.

**My recommendation: Option A.** It's small, local, and doesn't touch anything that's still mock-backed.

Concretely, in `TransactionView.RunCustomerSearch`:

```csharp
var match = await customerApi.FindCustomerAsync(query);
// ...
var entityCustomer = new Customer
{
    CustomerId = match.CustomerId,
    FirstName = match.FirstName,
    LastName = match.LastName,
    ContactNumber = match.ContactNumber,
    Email = match.Email,
    Birthday = match.Birthday,
    LastVisitDate = match.LastVisitDate,
    PointsBalance = match.PointsBalance,
    IsActive = match.IsActive,
};
ShowCustomerProfile(match);          // still uses DTO for display
SelectCustomer(entityCustomer);      // still uses entity for TransactionController
```

`ShowCustomerProfile` can take the DTO (it only reads `FullName`, `PointsBalance`, `Tier`, `ContactNumber` — all on the DTO).

That works. Small.

Replace the entire file with this:

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.domain.entities;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Services;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Controller for the Transactions/POS tab (MVC). One instance represents a single
    /// in-progress sale for one customer. Owns every business rule for the cart/promo/
    /// checkout flow — cart-item pricing, discount calculation, promo eligibility,
    /// points-earned math.
    ///
    /// Still mock-backed: IOrderService / IProductCatalogService / ICampaignService are
    /// the in-memory mocks until the Orders feature area is migrated to the API. The
    /// Customer entity is passed in by the View (converted from CustomerResponseDto).
    /// </summary>
    public class TransactionController
    {
        private readonly IOrderService _orderService;
        private readonly IProductCatalogService _catalogService;
        private readonly ICampaignService _campaignService;

        public Order Order { get; private set; }
        public Customer Customer { get; private set; }

        public IReadOnlyList<string> Categories { get; }

        public decimal SubTotal => Order.SubTotal;
        public decimal TotalDiscount => Order.TotalDiscount;
        public decimal TotalAmount => Order.TotalAmount;
        public bool HasItems => Order.OrderItems.Count > 0;
        public IReadOnlyList<OrderItem> CartItems => Order.OrderItems.ToList();

        public TransactionController(
            IOrderService orderService,
            IProductCatalogService catalogService,
            ICampaignService campaignService,
            Customer customer,
            int createdByEmployeeId)
        {
            _orderService = orderService;
            _catalogService = catalogService;
            _campaignService = campaignService;
            Customer = customer;
            Order = _orderService.StartOrder(customer.CustomerId, createdByEmployeeId);
            Categories = _catalogService.GetCategories();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Re-points the SAME in-progress order at a different customer (Quick Register
        /// relink flow). Not used by the main POS flow — search-and-Go there starts a fresh
        /// Controller/Order instead (see TransactionView.SelectCustomer).
        /// </summary>
        public void SwitchCustomer(Customer newCustomer)
        {
            Order = _orderService.LinkCustomerToOrder(Order, newCustomer);
            Customer = newCustomer;
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<Product> GetProducts(string category, string searchText)
        {
            IEnumerable<Product> products = string.IsNullOrEmpty(category)
                ? _catalogService.GetProducts()
                : _catalogService.GetByCategory(category);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchText))
                products = products.Where(p => p.ProductName.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

            return products.ToList();
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<ProductModifier> GetModifiers() => _catalogService.GetModifiers();

        public void AddItemToCart(Product product, ProductSize size, int quantity, IEnumerable<ProductModifier> modifiers)
        {
            EnsurePending();
            if (quantity <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Quantity must be greater than zero.");

            var existing = Order.OrderItems.FirstOrDefault(i => i.ProductSizeId == size.ProductSizeId);
            if (existing != null)
            {
                existing.Quantity += quantity;
                RecalculateItemPricing(existing);
            }
            else
            {
                var item = _orderService.CreateOrderItem(Order, product, size, quantity);
                foreach (var modifier in modifiers)
                    _orderService.AddModifierToItem(item, modifier);
                RecalculateItemPricing(item);
            }

            RecalculateOrderTotals();
        }

        public void UpdateCartItem(OrderItem item, ProductSize newSize, int newQuantity, IEnumerable<ProductModifier> newModifiers)
        {
            EnsurePending();
            if (newQuantity <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Quantity must be greater than zero.");

            if (item.ProductSizeId == newSize.ProductSizeId)
            {
                item.Quantity = newQuantity;
                item.OrderItemModifiers.Clear();
                foreach (var modifier in newModifiers)
                    _orderService.AddModifierToItem(item, modifier);
                RecalculateItemPricing(item);
                RecalculateOrderTotals();
            }
            else
            {
                _orderService.RemoveOrderItem(Order, item);
                AddItemToCart(item.Product!, newSize, newQuantity, newModifiers);
            }
        }

        public void RemoveItem(OrderItem item)
        {
            _orderService.RemoveOrderItem(Order, item);
            RecalculateOrderTotals();
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<Campaign> GetEligiblePromos() =>
            _campaignService.GetActiveCampaigns().Where(c => CanRedeem(c, Customer, Order)).ToList();

        public void ApplyPromo(Campaign campaign)
        {
            EnsurePending();
            var discount = CalculateDiscount(campaign, Order.SubTotal);
            _orderService.CreateCampaignRedeem(Order, campaign, discount);
            RecalculateOrderTotals();
        }

        public void RemovePromo(Campaign campaign)
        {
            var redeem = Order.CampaignRedeems.FirstOrDefault(r => r.CampaignId == campaign.CampaignId);
            if (redeem is null) return;

            _orderService.RemoveCampaignRedeem(Order, redeem);
            RecalculateOrderTotals();
        }

        public void ClearPromos()
        {
            foreach (var redeem in Order.CampaignRedeems.ToList())
                _orderService.RemoveCampaignRedeem(Order, redeem);

            RecalculateOrderTotals();
        }

        public Order CompleteSale()
        {
            EnsurePending();
            if (Order.OrderItems.Count == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Order cannot be empty.");

            Order.Status = "Completed";
            Order.PointsEarned = (int)(Order.TotalAmount / 10m);

            if (Order.PointsEarned > 0)
            {
                Customer.PointsBalance += Order.PointsEarned;
                Customer.LastVisitDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
                Customer.PointLedgers.Add(new PointLedger
                {
                    CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId,
                    PointsChange = Order.PointsEarned,
                    Type = "Earned",
                    Reason = $"Order #{Order.OrderId} Spend",
                    OrderId = Order.OrderId,
                    Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
                });
            }

            _orderService.CompleteOrder(Order);
            return Order;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // BUSINESS RULES
        // =====================================================================

        private void EnsurePending()
        {
            if (!Order.Status.Equals("Pending", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Order cannot be modified in '{Order.Status}' state.");
        }

        private static void RecalculateItemPricing(OrderItem item)
        {
            item.UnitPrice = item.BaseSizePrice + item.OrderItemModifiers.Sum(m => m.UnitPrice);
            item.SubTotal = item.Quantity * item.UnitPrice;
        }

        private void RecalculateOrderTotals()
        {
            Order.SubTotal = Order.OrderItems.Sum(i => i.SubTotal);

            decimal totalDiscount = 0m;
            foreach (var redeem in Order.CampaignRedeems)
            {
                var campaign = redeem.Campaign ?? _campaignService.GetById(redeem.CampaignId);
                var discount = campaign != null ? CalculateDiscount(campaign, Order.SubTotal) : redeem.DiscountUsed;
                redeem.DiscountUsed = discount;
                totalDiscount += discount;
            }
            Order.TotalDiscount = totalDiscount;

            Order.TotalAmount = Math.Max(0m, Order.SubTotal - Order.TotalDiscount);
        }

        private static bool IsCurrentlyActive(Campaign campaign)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            return campaign.IsActive && now >= campaign.StartDate && now <= campaign.EndDate;
        }

        private static bool CanRedeem(Campaign campaign, Customer customer, Order order)
        {
            if (!IsCurrentlyActive(campaign)) return false;

            if (campaign.MinPurchaseAmount.HasValue && order.SubTotal < campaign.MinPurchaseAmount.Value)
                return false;

            if (!campaign.TargetTier.Equals("All", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                !PointsToTier(customer.PointsBalance).Equals(campaign.TargetTier, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return false;

            if (campaign.PromoCategory.Equals("Birthday", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !IsBirthdayToday(customer))
                return false;

            if (campaign.PromoCategory.Equals("Inactive", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !IsInactive(customer))
                return false;

            var previousRedemptions = campaign.CampaignRedeems.Count(r => r.Order != null && r.Order.CustomerId == customer.CustomerId);
            return previousRedemptions < campaign.MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer;
        }

        private static string PointsToTier(int pointsBalance) => pointsBalance switch
        {
            >= 500 => "Gold",
            >= 200 => "Silver",
            _ => "Regular",
        };

        private static bool IsBirthdayToday(Customer customer) =>
            customer.Birthday?.Month == DateTime.UtcNow.Month && customer.Birthday?.Day == DateTime.UtcNow.Day;

        private static bool IsInactive(Customer customer) => (DateTime.UtcNow - customer.LastVisitDate).Days > 20;

        private static decimal CalculateDiscount(Campaign campaign, decimal orderTotal)
        {
            if (orderTotal <= 0) return 0m;
            if (campaign.MinPurchaseAmount.HasValue && orderTotal < campaign.MinPurchaseAmount.Value) return 0m;

            decimal discount;
            if (campaign.DiscountType.Equals("Percentage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                discount = orderTotal * (campaign.DiscountValue / 100m);
                if (campaign.MaxDiscountAmount.HasValue && discount > campaign.MaxDiscountAmount.Value)
                    discount = campaign.MaxDiscountAmount.Value;
            }
            else
            {
                discount = campaign.DiscountValue;
            }

            return discount > orderTotal ? orderTotal : discount;
        }
    }
}
```

- `CanRedeem` uses a local `PointsToTier` helper instead of `CustomerController.GetTier(...)`.
- Everything else identical.

```csharp
        // =====================================================================
        // CUSTOMER SELECTION (API-backed)
        // =====================================================================

        private async void RunCustomerSearch()
        {
            var query = _customerSearchTxtBx.Text.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query))
                return;

            try
            {
                var customerApi = new CustomerApi();
                var match = await customerApi.FindCustomerAsync(query);

                if (match is null)
                {
                    _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = $"No customer found for \"{query}\".";
                    _customerProfilePanel.Visible = false;
                    return;
                }

                _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = string.Empty;
                ShowCustomerProfile(match);
                SelectCustomer(match);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = ex.Message;
                _customerProfilePanel.Visible = false;
            }
        }

        private void ShowCustomerProfile(CustomerResponseDto customer)
        {
            _customerProfileNameLabel.Text = customer.FullName;
            _customerProfileDetailLabel.Text = $"{customer.Tier} Tier   •   {customer.PointsBalance} pts\n{customer.ContactNumber}";
            _customerProfilePanel.Visible = true;
        }

        private void SelectCustomer(CustomerResponseDto dto)
        {
            var employeeId = EmployeeSession.Current?.EmployeeId
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No employee session — the Transaction view requires a logged-in employee.");

            if (_controller is not null && _controller.CartItems.Count > 0)
            {
                var currentCustomerName = _controller.Customer.FullName;
                var confirm = MessageBox.Show(
                    FindForm(),
                    $"Discard the in-progress order for {currentCustomerName} and start a new one for {dto.FullName}?",
                    "Start New Transaction",
                    MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
                    MessageBoxIcon.Warning);

                if (confirm != DialogResult.Yes)
                {
                    _customerSearchTxtBx.Text = _controller.Customer.CustomerId.ToString();
                    return;
                }
            }

            // Convert DTO → entity for the still-mock-backed TransactionController.
            var entity = new Customer
            {
                CustomerId = dto.CustomerId,
                FirstName = dto.FirstName,
                LastName = dto.LastName,
                ContactNumber = dto.ContactNumber,
                Email = dto.Email,
                Birthday = dto.Birthday,
                LastVisitDate = dto.LastVisitDate,
                PointsBalance = dto.PointsBalance,
                IsActive = dto.IsActive,
            };

            _controller = new TransactionController(_orderService, _catalogService, _campaignService, entity, employeeId);

            RefreshProductsPanel();
            RefreshCartLines();
            RefreshSummary();
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // PROMO
        // =====================================================================

        private void ShowPromoMenu()
        {
            if (_controller is null)
                return;

            var menu = new ContextMenuStrip();

            if (_controller.Order.CampaignRedeems.Count > 0)
            {
                var clear = menu.Items.Add("Clear applied promo");
                clear.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9f);
                clear.Click += (s, e) =>
                {
                    _controller.ClearPromos();
                    RefreshSummary();
                    RefreshPromoButton();
                };
                menu.Items.Add(new ToolStripSeparator());
            }

            var eligiblePromos = _controller.GetEligiblePromos();
            if (eligiblePromos.Count == 0)
            {
                var none = menu.Items.Add("No promos available for this order");
                none.Enabled = false;
            }
            else
            {
                foreach (var campaign in eligiblePromos)
                {
                    var alreadyApplied = _controller.Order.CampaignRedeems
                        .Any(r => r.CampaignId == campaign.CampaignId);

                    var label = campaign.DiscountType == "Percentage"
                        ? $"{campaign.PromoName} — {campaign.DiscountValue:0.##}% off"
                        : $"{campaign.PromoName} — ₱{campaign.DiscountValue:0.##} off";
                    if (alreadyApplied)
                        label += "  (applied)";

                    var item = menu.Items.Add(label);
                    item.Enabled = !alreadyApplied;
                    item.Click += (s, e) =>
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            _controller.ApplyPromo(campaign);
                            RefreshSummary();
                            RefreshPromoButton();
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            ShowCartStatus(ex.Message);
                        }
                    };
                }
            }

            menu.Show(_promoMenuBtn, new Point(0, -menu.PreferredSize.Height));
        }

        private void RefreshPromoButton()
        {
            if (_controller is null)
            {
                _promoMenuBtn.Text = "Select a Promo ▾";
                _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            var applied = _controller.Order.CampaignRedeems.FirstOrDefault();

            if (applied is null)
            {
                _promoMenuBtn.Text = "Select a Promo ▾";
            }
            else
            {
                var campaign = _controller.GetEligiblePromos()
                                   .FirstOrDefault(c => c.CampaignId == applied.CampaignId)
                               ?? _campaignService.GetById(applied.CampaignId);

                var name = campaign?.PromoName ?? $"Promo #{applied.CampaignId}";
                _promoMenuBtn.Text = $"{name} ▾";
            }

            _promoMenuBtn.Enabled = true;
        }

        private void RefreshSummary()
        {
            RefreshPromoButton();

            if (_controller is null)
            {
                _subTotalValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _discountValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _vatValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _pwdSeniorValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _totalValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
                _logSaleBtn.Enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            _subTotalValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_controller.SubTotal:0.00}";
            _discountValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_controller.TotalDiscount:0.00}";
            _vatValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_controller.TotalAmount * VatRate:0.00}";
            _pwdSeniorValueLabel.Text = "₱0.00";
            _totalValueLabel.Text = $"₱{_controller.TotalAmount:0.00}";
            _logSaleBtn.Enabled = _controller.HasItems;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // DRINKS / CART
        // =====================================================================

        private void BuildCategoryOptions()
        {
            _categoryCombo.Items.Clear();
            _categoryCombo.Items.Add(AllCategoriesOption);
            foreach (var category in _catalogService.GetCategories())
                _categoryCombo.Items.Add(category);
            _categoryCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        private void RefreshProductsPanel()
        {
            _productsFlowPanel.Controls.Clear();
            if (_controller is null) return;

            var products = _controller.GetProducts(_selectedCategory, _productSearchTxtBx.Text);
            foreach (var product in products)
            {
                var card = new ProductCardControl(product);
                card.CardClicked += (s, e) => OpenCustomizerForNewItem(product);
                card.SizeQuickAdded += (s, size) => QuickAddToCart(product, size);
                _productsFlowPanel.Controls.Add(card);
            }
        }

        private void QuickAddToCart(Product product, ProductSize size)
        {
            if (_controller is null)
            {
                ShowCartStatus("Pick a customer on the left first.");
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                _controller.AddItemToCart(product, size, 1, Enumerable.Empty<ProductModifier>());
                RefreshCartLines();
                RefreshSummary();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowCartStatus(ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private void OpenCustomizerForNewItem(Product product)
        {
            if (_controller is null)
            {
                ShowCartStatus("Pick a customer on the left first.");
                return;
            }

            using var form = new FrmItemCustomizer(product, _controller.GetModifiers());

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                try
                {
                    _controller.AddItemToCart(product, form.SelectedSize, form.Quantity, form.SelectedModifiers);
                    RefreshCartLines();
                    RefreshSummary();
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ShowCartStatus(ex.Message);
                }
            }
        }

        private void RefreshCartLines()
        {
            _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Clear();

            if (_controller is null || _controller.CartItems.Count == 0)
            {
                _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Add(_cartEmptyLabel);
                return;
            }

            var lineWidth = Math.Max(200,
                _cartLinesPanel.ClientSize.Width - SystemInformation.VerticalScrollBarWidth - 8);

            foreach (var item in _controller.CartItems)
            {
                var line = new CartLineControl(item) { Width = lineWidth };
                line.QuantityIncreased += (s, e) => ChangeQuantity(item, +1);
                line.QuantityDecreased += (s, e) => ChangeQuantity(item, -1);
                line.RemoveClicked += (s, e) => RemoveFromCart(item);
                _cartLinesPanel.Controls.Add(line);
            }
        }

        private void RemoveFromCart(OrderItem item)
        {
            if (_controller is null) return;

            _controller.RemoveItem(item);
            RefreshCartLines();
            RefreshSummary();
        }

        private void ChangeQuantity(OrderItem item, int delta)
        {
            if (_controller is null || item.Product is null) return;

            var newQuantity = item.Quantity + delta;
            if (newQuantity <= 0)
            {
                RemoveFromCart(item);
                return;
            }

            var size = item.Product.ProductSizes.First(s => s.ProductSizeId == item.ProductSizeId);
            var modifiers = _controller.GetModifiers()
                .Where(m => item.OrderItemModifiers.Any(om => om.ProductModifierId == m.ProductModifierId));

            try
            {
                _controller.UpdateCartItem(item, size, newQuantity, modifiers);
                RefreshCartLines();
                RefreshSummary();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowCartStatus(ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private void ShowCartStatus(string message) => _cartStatusLabel.Text = message;

        private void CompleteSale()
        {
            if (_controller is null) return;

            try
            {
                var customerName = _controller.Customer.FullName;
                var order = _controller.CompleteSale();

                MessageBox.Show(FindForm(),
                    $"Sale completed. {order.PointsEarned} points awarded to {customerName}.",
                    "Sale Complete", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);

                _controller = null;
                _customerProfilePanel.Visible = false;
                _customerSearchErrorLabel.Text = string.Empty;
                _customerSearchTxtBx.Text = string.Empty;
                RefreshProductsPanel();
                RefreshCartLines();
                RefreshSummary();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowCartStatus(ex.Message);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

- `SelectCustomer` takes a `CustomerResponseDto`, converts it to a `Customer` entity, and hands that to `TransactionController`.
- `ShowCustomerProfile` takes a `CustomerResponseDto`.

```csharp
    /// <summary>
    /// The Feedback tab: ticket grid + read-only drawer. Staff log and view; deciding
    /// (resolve/dismiss/award) is a manager concern on a future surface.
    ///
    /// Still mock-backed via ServiceRegistry.Feedback until the Feedback feature area
    /// migrates to the API.
    /// </summary>
    public partial class FeedbackManagementView : UserControl
    {
        private readonly FeedbackController _controller;
        private readonly BindingSource _ticketsBindingSource = new();

        private Feedback? _selectedTicket;

        public FeedbackManagementView()
            : this(ServiceRegistry.Feedback)
        {
        }

        public FeedbackManagementView(IFeedbackService feedbackService)
        {
            _controller = new FeedbackController(feedbackService);
            InitializeComponent();

            ConfigureTicketsGridColumns();

            ticketsGrid.DataSource = _ticketsBindingSource;
            ticketsGrid.SelectionChanged += TicketsGrid_SelectionChanged;
            ticketsGrid.CellFormatting += TicketsGrid_CellFormatting;

            searchTxtBx.TextChanged += (s, e) => ReloadTickets();
            logFeedbackBtn.Click += (s, e) => OpenLogFeedbackModal();

            cardHeaderPanel.Resize += (s, e) => PositionActionButton();
            PositionActionButton();

            ReloadTickets();
        }

        private void PositionActionButton()
        {
            logFeedbackBtn.Left = cardHeaderPanel.ClientSize.Width - logFeedbackBtn.Width - 16;
            logFeedbackBtn.Top = 14;
        }

        private void ReloadTickets()
        {
            var previousId = _selectedTicket?.TicketId;
            var tickets = _controller.GetTickets(searchTxtBx.Text);
            _ticketsBindingSource.DataSource = tickets.ToList();

            var stillPresent = previousId.HasValue ? tickets.FirstOrDefault(t => t.TicketId == previousId.Value) : null;
            if (stillPresent != null)
            {
                SelectTicketRowById(stillPresent.TicketId);
            }
            else
            {
                _selectedTicket = null;
                RefreshDrawer();
            }
        }

        private void TicketsGrid_SelectionChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _selectedTicket = ticketsGrid.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem as Feedback;
            RefreshDrawer();
        }

        private void TicketsGrid_CellFormatting(object? sender, DataGridViewCellFormattingEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ticketsGrid.Rows[e.RowIndex].DataBoundItem is not Feedback ticket)
                return;

            var columnName = ticketsGrid.Columns[e.ColumnIndex].Name;
            if (columnName == "CustomerName")
            {
                e.Value = ticket.Customer?.FullName ?? "—";
                e.FormattingApplied = true;
            }
            else if (columnName == "RatingDisplay")
            {
                e.Value = $"{ticket.Rating}/5";
                e.FormattingApplied = true;
            }
        }

        private void OpenLogFeedbackModal()
        {
            using var form = new FrmLogFeedback(_controller, EmployeeSession.Current!.EmployeeId);

            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK && form.CreatedFeedback != null)
            {
                ReloadTickets();
                SelectTicketRowById(form.CreatedFeedback.TicketId);
            }
        }

        private void RefreshDrawer()
        {
            var ticket = _selectedTicket;
            if (ticket is null)
            {
                drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = true;
                drawerContentPanel.Visible = false;
                return;
            }

            drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = false;
            drawerContentPanel.Visible = true;

            ticketCustomerLabel.Text = ticket.Customer?.FullName ?? "—";
            ticketRatingLabel.Text = new string('★', ticket.Rating) + new string('☆', 5 - ticket.Rating);
            ticketCategoryLabel.Text = $"Category: {ticket.Category}";
            ticketStatusLabel.Text = $"Status: {ticket.Status}";
            ticketDateLabel.Text = $"Logged {ticket.DateLogged:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} by {ticket.LoggedByEmployee?.FullName ?? "—"}";
            ticketNotesLabel.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ticket.StaffNotes) ? "(no notes)" : ticket.StaffNotes;
        }

        private void SelectTicketRowById(int ticketId)
        {
            foreach (DataGridViewRow row in ticketsGrid.Rows)
            {
                if (row.DataBoundItem is Feedback f && f.TicketId == ticketId)
                {
                    ticketsGrid.ClearSelection();
                    row.Selected = true;
                    ticketsGrid.CurrentCell = row.Cells[0];
                    _selectedTicket = f;
                    RefreshDrawer();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        private void ConfigureTicketsGridColumns()
        {
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Clear();
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.TicketId),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.TicketId),
                HeaderText = "Ticket #",
                Width = 70,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = "CustomerName",
                HeaderText = "Customer",
                Width = 160,
                AutoSizeMode = DataGridViewAutoSizeColumnMode.Fill,
                SortMode = DataGridViewColumnSortMode.NotSortable,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = "RatingDisplay",
                HeaderText = "Rating",
                Width = 60,
                SortMode = DataGridViewColumnSortMode.NotSortable,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.Category),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.Category),
                HeaderText = "Category",
                Width = 90,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.Status),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.Status),
                HeaderText = "Status",
                Width = 90,
            });
            ticketsGrid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn
            {
                Name = nameof(Feedback.DateLogged),
                DataPropertyName = nameof(Feedback.DateLogged),
                HeaderText = "Logged",
                Width = 130,
                DefaultCellStyle = new DataGridViewCellStyle { Format = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm" },
            });
        }
    }
}
```

# File 9b — `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms/Controllers/FeedbackController.cs` (full replacement)

Because `ICustomerService` is being deleted, `FeedbackController` can't take it anymore. It only used it for the `SearchCustomers` method (customer picker in the log-feedback modal). Let me look at what it did there.

From your earlier paste, `FeedbackController` had:

```csharp
private readonly IFeedbackService _feedbackService;
private readonly ICustomerService _customerService;
```

And it used `_customerService.Search(query)` in `SearchCustomers`.

The cleanest fix: `FeedbackController` drops `ICustomerService`, and `SearchCustomers` moves to using `CustomerApi` directly — same as `CustomerController` does now.

Replace `FeedbackController.cs` with:

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.domain.entities;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Services;
using CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services.Api;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Controller for the Feedback tab (MVC). Log and view feedback; the resolve/dismiss
    /// decision belongs to a manager surface.
    ///
    /// Feedback persistence is still mock-backed via IFeedbackService until the Feedback
    /// feature area migrates. Customer lookups (for the log-feedback modal's picker) go
    /// through CustomerApi — the real DB — because Customers has already migrated.
    /// </summary>
    public class FeedbackController
    {
        private readonly IFeedbackService _feedbackService;
        private readonly CustomerApi _customerApi;

        public FeedbackController(IFeedbackService feedbackService)
        {
            _feedbackService = feedbackService;
            _customerApi = new CustomerApi();
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<Feedback> GetTickets(string searchText)
        {
            var all = _feedbackService.GetAll();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchText))
                return all;

            return all.Where(t =>
                (t.Customer?.FullName.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
                t.Category.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                t.Status.Contains(searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                t.TicketId.ToString() == searchText.Trim())
                .ToList();
        }

        /// <summary>Customer search for the Log Feedback modal — hits the API.</summary>
        public async Task<List<CustomerResponseDto>> SearchCustomersAsync(string query)
            => await _customerApi.GetCustomersAsync(query);

        public Feedback LogFeedback(int customerId, int loggedByEmployeeId, int rating, string category, string staffNotes) =>
            _feedbackService.LogFeedback(customerId, loggedByEmployeeId, rating, category, staffNotes.Trim());
    }
}
```

**Note:** `SearchCustomersAsync` is now async. That means `FrmLogFeedback.cs` also has to change — its customer search results list is populated by calling `_controller.SearchCustomers(...)` synchronously today. That's coming in file 9c.

Good catch — that's a real mismatch. `IFeedbackService` in your current project no longer has `LogFeedback`. Let me check the interface shape we saw earlier.

From the interface bundle:

```csharp
public interface IFeedbackService
{
    Feedback Save(Feedback feedback);        // ← this is what's on it now, not LogFeedback
    IReadOnlyList<Feedback> GetForCustomer(int customerId);
    IReadOnlyList<Feedback> GetAll();
    Feedback ResolveFeedback(...);
    Feedback DismissFeedback(...);
}
```

The refactor moved from `LogFeedback(...)` (which took primitives) to `Save(Feedback)` (which takes a constructed entity). Same pattern as `ICustomerService` — service is pure persistence, controller builds the entity.

So the fix is: `FeedbackController.LogFeedback` must construct the `Feedback` entity and call `Save`.

Replace the `LogFeedback` method in `FeedbackController.cs` with:

```csharp
public Feedback LogFeedback(int customerId, int loggedByEmployeeId, int rating, string category, string staffNotes)
{
    if (rating < 1 || rating > 5)
        throw new ArgumentException("Rating must be between 1 and 5 stars.");
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(category))
        throw new ArgumentException("Category is required.");

    var feedback = new Feedback
    {
        CustomerId = customerId,
        LoggedBy = loggedByEmployeeId,
        Rating = rating,
        Category = category.Trim(),
        StaffNotes = staffNotes?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
        Status = "Pending",
        DateLogged = DateTime.UtcNow,
        IsActive = true,
        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
    };

    return _feedbackService.Save(feedback);
}
```

**Note:** `Feedback` is `BaseEntity` and its properties were `private-set` in the original bundle. If they're still private-set, this won't compile — you'll get the same "cannot assign" errors we hit with `PointAdjustmentRequest`/`PointLedger`. **If you hit those, make `Feedback`'s properties public-set** in `CRM_Morcaffein.domain/entities/Feedback.cs` — same fix as before:

```csharp
public int TicketId { get; set; }
public int CustomerId { get; set; }
public int LoggedBy { get; set; }
public int Rating { get; set; }
public string Category { get; set; } = string.Empty;
public string StaffNotes { get; set; } = string.Empty;
public string Status { get; set; } = "Pending";
public DateTime DateLogged { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
public int? DecidedBy { get; set; }
public DateTime? DecidedAt { get; set; }
public string? DecisionNotes { get; set; }
```

And the nav properties:

```csharp
public virtual Customer? Customer { get; set; }
public virtual Employee? LoggedByEmployee { get; set; }
public virtual Employee? DecidedByEmployee { get; set; }
```

## The replacement

In `ServiceRegistry.cs`, replace `PlaceholderStaffAccount`:

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Hardcoded placeholder for "the currently logged in employee" during development,
/// until FrmLogin/auth is wired up. This is a dev-only stand-in — the employee does
/// NOT exist in the database. When real login is built, delete this property and let
/// FrmLogin set EmployeeSession.Current from the authenticated API response.
///
/// Renz Arriola, role Manager — allows testing the point-adjustment REQUEST flow
/// (Manager+) but hides approve/reject (Admin+) in this app, matching the current
/// production intent that this is a staff console, not an admin console.
/// </summary>
public static Employee PlaceholderStaffAccount
{
    get
    {
        var employee = new Employee
        {
            EmployeeId = 1,
            FirstName = "Renz",
            LastName = "Arriola",
            ContactNumber = "09171234567",
            Email = "renz.arriola@morcaffein.com",
            Role = "Manager",
            IsActive = true,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
        };
        return employee;
    }
}
```

**Three things worth noting:**

1. **`EmployeeId = 1`** — the placeholder claims to be Employee 1. Every order/feedback it attributes will have `CreatedBy = 1`. If Employee 1 doesn't exist in the DB when we migrate Orders (which will write a real `CreatedBy` FK to `Employees`), the insert will fail with a foreign key violation. So — **do you already have any employees in the DB, or is the Employees table empty?** If empty, we'll need to seed at least one before Orders migration, OR use a nullable `CreatedBy` for now. Flag it for when we get to Orders.
2. **`Role = "Manager"`** — if you want to test the approve/reject side of point adjustments, change to `"Admin"`.
3. **`Employee` entity property setters** — this assumes they're public-set. From the earlier refactor, they should be. If `EmployeeId` is still private-set, you'll get a compile error and we fix that (make it public-set in `Employee.cs`).

Ah — classic DataGridView behavior. When the grid has exactly one row, WinForms auto-selects it and sets it as `CurrentRow`, so `SelectionChanged` fires with the row already highlighted. You can't "click it" because it's already the current row, so clicking it produces no change and no event.

Two things going on:

**1. The auto-select is happening on load.** When you bind a `BindingSource` with one row, the grid's `CurrentRow` becomes that row automatically. That's normal and hard to prevent without fighting the framework.

**2. The draw is that it fires `SelectionChanged` on auto-select** — so your `RefreshDrawerAsync` runs. That means **the drawer should already be showing the profile for that single customer.** If it isn't, that's the actual bug.

Wait, let me re-read: *"it works right now"*. So it *does* work — the profile loads because the single row is auto-selected. And your complaint is that you **can't re-click it** to, say, reload the drawer or to make the row visibly *selected* (highlighted) rather than just being the current row.

Actually — thinking about it more, what I think is happening:

- Grid has 1 row.
- WinForms auto-selects it (sets it as the CurrentRow), but **does not necessarily paint it as selected** unless `CurrentRow` and `Selected` are aligned. With `SelectionMode = FullRowSelect` and a single row, it usually does paint it.
- You click it. Nothing happens — because it's already the CurrentRow, so `SelectionChanged` doesn't fire.
- Your expectation: clicking a row should re-trigger the drawer, or trigger it in the first place.

**The cleanest fix:** don't rely on click. Populate the drawer on load as well as on selection change.

---

## The fix

In `CustomerManagementView.ReloadCustomersAsync()`, after populating the grid, if no customer is selected but the grid has rows, **select the first row and refresh the drawer**. That way, the drawer appears without the user needing to click.

Change `ReloadCustomersAsync`:

```csharp
private async Task ReloadCustomersAsync()
{
    var previousId = _selectedCustomer?.CustomerId;
    var results = await _controller.SearchAsync(searchTxtBx.Text);
    _customersBindingSource.DataSource = results;

    var stillPresent = previousId.HasValue
        ? results.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CustomerId == previousId.Value)
        : null;

    if (stillPresent != null)
    {
        SelectCustomerRowById(stillPresent.CustomerId);
    }
    else if (results.Count > 0)
    {
        // No previous selection — default to the first row so the drawer populates
        // without requiring a click. Single-row grids auto-select but don't fire
        // SelectionChanged reliably, so we set the selection explicitly.
        SelectCustomerRowById(results[0].CustomerId);
    }
    else
    {
        _selectedCustomer = null;
        await RefreshDrawerAsync();
    }
}
```

**What this does:** after loading, if nothing was previously selected and there's at least one row, it programmatically selects the first row (using the existing `SelectCustomerRowById` helper, which already handles the selection + drawer refresh).

**Result:** the drawer shows on landing. Clicking another row still works. Clicking the *same* row doesn't need to do anything because the drawer is already showing.

## But — is that what you actually want?

Let me re-read your message one more time: *"can i make it so that it doesnt automatically point to it so i can still click it"*

Reading it again — I think you want **the opposite of what I just suggested.** You *don't* want auto-selection. You want the grid to load with **no row selected**, so you can then click the single row and have the drawer appear on the click.

**That's a different fix.** And it's doable:

In `ReloadCustomersAsync`, after binding the data source, explicitly clear the grid's selection and current cell:

```csharp
private async Task ReloadCustomersAsync()
{
    var previousId = _selectedCustomer?.CustomerId;
    var results = await _controller.SearchAsync(searchTxtBx.Text);
    _customersBindingSource.DataSource = results;

    // Clear any auto-selection so the user has to click a row to see its profile.
    customersGrid.ClearSelection();
    customersGrid.CurrentCell = null;

    var stillPresent = previousId.HasValue
        ? results.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CustomerId == previousId.Value)
        : null;

    if (stillPresent != null)
    {
        SelectCustomerRowById(stillPresent.CustomerId);
    }
    else
    {
        _selectedCustomer = null;
        await RefreshDrawerAsync();
    }
}
```

**Result:** grid loads with nothing selected, drawer shows the "Select a customer" empty state. You click the row → `SelectionChanged` fires → drawer populates.

**One caveat:** `customersGrid.CurrentCell = null;` sometimes throws `InvalidOperationException` if the grid doesn't allow null current cell in certain states. If it errors, wrap in a try/catch or use `customersGrid.ClearSelection();` alone (which clears Selected but might leave a CurrentRow). Tell me if it errors and I'll provide the workaround.

That's a WinForms DataGridView behavior — it's showing the **"cell tooltip"** — but what you're describing (a pop-out that shows the full content of the cell and gets stuck) sounds like a specific interaction bug. Let me pin it down.

The DataGridView has two tooltip-ish things:

1. **Cell tooltips** — set via `ShowCellToolTips = true` (default), shows the full cell text when the content is truncated by the column width. Auto-hides when you move away.
2. **Cell error text** — the little icon + balloon that appears when `cell.ErrorText` is set.

What you're describing (pop-out showing the "full" cell content, sticky, doesn't close) matches **#1 triggering and not dismissing**. That happens when:

- The mouse hovers a cell whose text is longer than the column, so WinForms shows the full content.
- The grid has focus but the mouse leaves quickly, and the tooltip doesn't get a hide message.
- This is a well-known WinForms DataGridView quirk — it happens more often when `ShowCellToolTips` is true **and** the grid is inside a `Panel` with custom painting or a `FlowLayoutPanel`.

**The fix is one line per grid:**

```csharp
grid.ShowCellToolTips = false;
```

**Where:** in `ConfigureGrid`, in `CustomerManagementView.Designer.cs`. There's one shared `ConfigureGrid` method that all four grids go through:

```csharp
private static void ConfigureGrid(DataGridView grid, float headerSize, int rowHeight)
{
    grid.BackgroundColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
    grid.AllowUserToAddRows = false;
    grid.AllowUserToDeleteRows = false;
    grid.AllowUserToResizeRows = false;
    grid.ReadOnly = true;
    grid.RowHeadersVisible = false;
    grid.MultiSelect = false;
    grid.SelectionMode = DataGridViewSelectionMode.FullRowSelect;
    grid.AutoGenerateColumns = false;
    grid.EnableHeadersVisualStyles = false;
    grid.ShowCellToolTips = false;   // ← add this line
    grid.GridColor = BrandPalette.Border;
    // ... rest unchanged ...
}
```

**Same fix in the other management views** — `FeedbackManagementView.Designer.cs` has an equivalent `ConfigureGrid` method. Add the same line there.

**Same fix in any grid that has the issue.** If `StarRatingControl` or other views have grids, do it there too.

---

## Why this is happening (for context)

When `ShowCellToolTips = true`, WinForms shows a small tooltip window when:

- The cell's text is longer than the visible column width, **or**
- The cursor hovers a cell for ~1 second

It's supposed to hide on mouse-leave. It doesn't always, especially if:

- The grid is inside a control that doesn't reliably forward mouse events
- The app has a modal dialog open (the tooltip's parent window is disabled)
- A layout change happens while the tooltip is visible

The "slight delay then pop-out" you're seeing is the built-in ~1-second hover timer firing.

**Disabling `ShowCellToolTips` removes the whole class of bug.** Trade-off: you lose the "hover to see full truncated text" behavior — but since your columns are mostly sized to fit their content, and the drawer shows full details anyway, that's not a loss.

---

## Apply it

1. Open `CustomerManagementView.Designer.cs`.
2. Find the `ConfigureGrid` method (it's at the bottom of the class).
3. Add `grid.ShowCellToolTips = false;` to it.

Then do the same in `FeedbackManagementView.Designer.cs` (its `ConfigureGrid` method).

Rebuild. The stuck pop-out should be gone.

---

**After that, we're ready for Campaigns migration.** Confirm the fix worked, and confirm the Barista role gating is correct (approve/reject hidden, request form shown), then we start.

# Campaigns Migration — Step 1 of the remaining 4

Same pattern as Customers. Read through before pasting — this one's smaller because Campaigns is read-only (the API has only two methods).

## What's happening

Campaigns is **read-only in the app** — the POS "Select a Promo" menu asks for the eligible list, and the label lookup asks for one campaign by ID. There's no way to create/edit/delete a campaign through this app. So the API surface is just two endpoints.

## Files in this batch

**API side (create):**

1. `DTOs/CampaignResponseDto.cs`
2. `Controllers/CampaignController.cs`

**API side (edit):**

3. `Program.cs` — remove the throwaway `/tenant/{id}/campaigns` endpoint if you have one (you probably don't; skip if not)

**WinForms side (create):**

4. `Services/Api/CampaignApi.cs`

**WinForms side (edit):**

5. `Services/ServiceRegistry.cs` — remove the `Campaigns` property
6. `Controllers/TransactionController.cs` — remove `ICampaignService` dependency, inline the campaign lookups
7. `Views/Controls/TransactionView.cs` — construct `CampaignApi` instead of taking `ICampaignService`

**WinForms side (delete):**

8. `Services/ICampaignService.cs`
9. `Services/Mock/MockCampaignService.cs`

**Build.** Same as before — expect a few errors on the first build; we fix them.

# File 2 — `CRM_Morcaffein.api/Controllers/CampaignController.cs`

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.infrastructure.services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.api.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/tenant/{companyId:int}/campaigns")]
    public class CampaignController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly ITenantDbContextFactory _tenantFactory;

        public CampaignController(ITenantDbContextFactory tenantFactory)
        {
            _tenantFactory = tenantFactory;
        }

        // GET api/tenant/{companyId}/campaigns
        // Returns all currently-active campaigns (IsActive + within date range).
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<ActionResult<List<CampaignResponseDto>>> GetActiveCampaigns(int companyId)
        {
            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            var campaigns = await tenant.Campaigns
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(c => c.IsActive && now >= c.StartDate && now <= c.EndDate)
                .OrderBy(c => c.CampaignId)
                .Select(c => new CampaignResponseDto
                {
                    CampaignId = c.CampaignId,
                    PromoName = c.PromoName,
                    PromoCategory = c.PromoCategory,
                    DiscountType = c.DiscountType,
                    DiscountValue = c.DiscountValue,
                    TargetTier = c.TargetTier,
                    MinPurchaseAmount = c.MinPurchaseAmount,
                    MaxDiscountAmount = c.MaxDiscountAmount,
                    MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer = c.MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer,
                    StartDate = c.StartDate,
                    EndDate = c.EndDate,
                    IsActive = c.IsActive
                })
                .ToListAsync();

            return Ok(campaigns);
        }

        // GET api/tenant/{companyId}/campaigns/{id}
        [HttpGet("{id:int}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<CampaignResponseDto>> GetCampaign(int companyId, int id)
        {
            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            var campaign = await tenant.Campaigns
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(c => c.CampaignId == id)
                .Select(c => new CampaignResponseDto
                {
                    CampaignId = c.CampaignId,
                    PromoName = c.PromoName,
                    PromoCategory = c.PromoCategory,
                    DiscountType = c.DiscountType,
                    DiscountValue = c.DiscountValue,
                    TargetTier = c.TargetTier,
                    MinPurchaseAmount = c.MinPurchaseAmount,
                    MaxDiscountAmount = c.MaxDiscountAmount,
                    MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer = c.MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer,
                    StartDate = c.StartDate,
                    EndDate = c.EndDate,
                    IsActive = c.IsActive
                })
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

            if (campaign is null)
                return NotFound();

            return Ok(campaign);
        }
    }
}
```

# File 4 — `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms/Services/Api/CampaignApi.cs`

```csharp
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services.Api
{
    public class CampaignApi
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _http;

        public CampaignApi()
        {
            _http = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(ApiConfig.BaseUrl) };
        }

        public async Task<List<CampaignResponseDto>> GetActiveCampaignsAsync()
        {
            var response = await _http.GetAsync($"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/campaigns");
            await EnsureSuccess(response);
            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<List<CampaignResponseDto>>();
            return result ?? new List<CampaignResponseDto>();
        }

        public async Task<CampaignResponseDto?> GetByIdAsync(int campaignId)
        {
            var response = await _http.GetAsync($"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/campaigns/{campaignId}");
            if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.NotFound)
                return null;
            await EnsureSuccess(response);
            return await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CampaignResponseDto>();
        }

        private static async Task EnsureSuccess(HttpResponseMessage response)
        {
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode) return;
            var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(body)
                    ? $"API returned {(int)response.StatusCode}."
                    : body);
        }
    }
}
```

# File 6 — `TransactionController.cs` (edit)

**Remove the `ICampaignService` field and constructor param.**

Change the class fields from:

```csharp
private readonly IOrderService _orderService;
private readonly IProductCatalogService _catalogService;
private readonly ICampaignService _campaignService;
```

To:

```csharp
private readonly IOrderService _orderService;
private readonly IProductCatalogService _catalogService;
```

Change the constructor signature from:

```csharp
public TransactionController(
    IOrderService orderService,
    IProductCatalogService catalogService,
    ICampaignService campaignService,
    Customer customer,
    int createdByEmployeeId)
{
    _orderService = orderService;
    _catalogService = catalogService;
    _campaignService = campaignService;
    ...
}
```

To:

```csharp
public TransactionController(
    IOrderService orderService,
    IProductCatalogService catalogService,
    Customer customer,
    int createdByEmployeeId)
{
    _orderService = orderService;
    _catalogService = catalogService;
    ...
}
```

**`TransactionController` used `_campaignService` in two places:**

1. `GetEligiblePromos()` — currently:

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<Campaign> GetEligiblePromos() =>
    _campaignService.GetActiveCampaigns().Where(c => CanRedeem(c, Customer, Order)).ToList();
```

2. `RecalculateOrderTotals()` — the `_campaignService.GetById(...)` fallback for a redeem whose `Campaign` nav is null.

**Both need to work without an API call**, since the cart mutations (`AddItem`, `UpdateCartItem`, `RemoveItem`, `ApplyPromo`) happen synchronously. Making them async would ripple through the whole POS. So:

**Simplest fix:** the `TransactionController` gets the campaign list **once** at construction, from the View (which is async-friendly). Store it as a field.

**Add a field:**

```csharp
private readonly IReadOnlyList<Campaign> _activeCampaigns;
```

**Change the constructor to accept the campaign list:**

```csharp
public TransactionController(
    IOrderService orderService,
    IProductCatalogService catalogService,
    IReadOnlyList<Campaign> activeCampaigns,
    Customer customer,
    int createdByEmployeeId)
{
    _orderService = orderService;
    _catalogService = catalogService;
    _activeCampaigns = activeCampaigns;
    Customer = customer;
    Order = _orderService.StartOrder(customer.CustomerId, createdByEmployeeId);
    Categories = _catalogService.GetCategories();
}
```

**`GetEligiblePromos()` becomes:**

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<Campaign> GetEligiblePromos() =>
    _activeCampaigns.Where(c => CanRedeem(c, Customer, Order)).ToList();
```

**`RecalculateOrderTotals()` fallback changes from:**

```csharp
var campaign = redeem.Campaign ?? _campaignService.GetById(redeem.CampaignId);
```

**to:**

```csharp
var campaign = redeem.Campaign ?? _activeCampaigns.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CampaignId == redeem.CampaignId);
```

**And in `RefreshPromoButton` in `TransactionView.cs`** — that's where the second campaign lookup was. We'll handle that in file 7.

**Remove `ICampaignService` field and constructor param:**

Change:

To:

```csharp
public TransactionView(IOrderService orderService, IProductCatalogService catalogService)
{
```

**Where was `_campaignService` used?** In `RefreshPromoButton`:

```csharp
var campaign = _controller.GetEligiblePromos()
                   .FirstOrDefault(c => c.CampaignId == applied.CampaignId)
               ?? _campaignService.GetById(applied.CampaignId);
```

Replace with a call to `_controller.GetEligiblePromos()` only (the controller now has the campaign list):

```csharp
var campaign = _controller.GetEligiblePromos()
                   .FirstOrDefault(c => c.CampaignId == applied.CampaignId);
```

**And the `SelectCustomer` method** needs to fetch the campaign list from the API and pass it to `TransactionController`. Change:

```csharp
_controller = new TransactionController(_orderService, _catalogService, _campaignService, entity, employeeId);
```

To:

```csharp
// Fetch active campaigns from the API before constructing the controller.
var campaignApi = new CampaignApi();
var campaignDtos = await campaignApi.GetActiveCampaignsAsync();
var campaigns = campaignDtos.Select(MapToCampaignEntity).ToList();

_controller = new TransactionController(_orderService, _catalogService, campaigns, entity, employeeId);
```

**`SelectCustomer` becomes async.** Change its signature from:

```csharp
private void SelectCustomer(CustomerResponseDto dto)
```

To:

```csharp
private async Task SelectCustomerAsync(CustomerResponseDto dto)
```

And the caller in `RunCustomerSearch`:

```csharp
SelectCustomer(match);
```

becomes:

```csharp
await SelectCustomerAsync(match);
```

(`RunCustomerSearch` is already `async void`, so `await` works.)

**Add a mapping helper** near the bottom of `TransactionView`:

```csharp
private static Campaign MapToCampaignEntity(CampaignResponseDto dto) => new()
{
    CampaignId = dto.CampaignId,
    PromoName = dto.PromoName,
    PromoCategory = dto.PromoCategory,
    DiscountType = dto.DiscountType,
    DiscountValue = dto.DiscountValue,
    TargetTier = dto.TargetTier,
    MinPurchaseAmount = dto.MinPurchaseAmount,
    MaxDiscountAmount = dto.MaxDiscountAmount,
    MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer = dto.MaxRedemptionsPerCustomer,
    StartDate = dto.StartDate,
    EndDate = dto.EndDate,
    IsActive = dto.IsActive,
};
```

**Add the using at the top of `TransactionView.cs`:**

# Build checklist

Expected errors on first build (I'm predicting them so you know they're not surprises):

1. **`MockOrderService.cs`** might reference `ICampaignService` or `Campaign` in ways that break — check.
2. **Anything else that referenced `ServiceRegistry.Campaigns`** — probably only `TransactionView`, which we're fixing.
3. **`Campaign` entity property setters** — if any are `private set`, the mapping helper won't compile. From what I recall, `Campaign` is the one entity that already had public setters (it was never refactored), so this should be fine.

**If the build succeeds:** run the app, open Transactions, search a customer, click "Select a Promo". The menu should show the campaigns from the DB. Apply one, verify the discount appears in Payables.

**Report back the build result.** If clean → we do Feedback next.

```csharp
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
```
