## What changed vs. what I sent before

- **`brandMarkPanel` name preserved** — no rename.
- **Removed the fake `ImageBeforeText` property.** Replaced with `Padding = new Padding(44, 0, 0, 0)` on the button. The image is placed by `ImageAlign = MiddleLeft` **before** the padded text region. So left-to-right it's: `[0..~12: implicit image space] [icon ~12..36] [gap ~36..44] [text 44..]`. That's the standard technique.
- **Removed `BrandMarkPanel_Paint` method** and the `brandMarkPanel.Paint += ...` wiring. Now `LoadBrandMarkInto(brandMarkPanel)` sets the image as a background. If the panel had a colored background originally, it may show through the transparent PNG — you may want to set `brandMarkPanel.BackColor = Color.Transparent` or `BrandPalette.White`. I'll flag this after you see how it looks.

## Two caveats

**1. Icon + text spacing will need a visual tune.** The exact gap between the icon and the text is not perfectly controllable in WinForms. `Padding.Left = 44` gives about 8px of visual gap between a 24px icon and the text. If it looks too tight or too loose, adjust: `Padding.Left = 40` (tighter) or `48` (looser).

**2. Top bar panel background.** If `brandMarkPanel` had a non-transparent background color, the PNG (transparent) will show it around the edges. Since the brand icon is 32×32 and the panel is 32×32, `ImageLayout.Zoom` will fill it. **If the panel shows a colored square around the icon**, set `brandMarkPanel.BackColor = Color.Transparent` and confirm the parent (topBarPanel) has a white background.

## Also — one warning

The `LoadBrandMarkInto(brandMarkPanel)` call replaces what used to be the painted "M" circle. If you **also** had `brandMarkPanel.Paint += BrandMarkPanel_Paint;` wired in the constructor — that's removed now. Good.

Two problems, both fixable. Let me address them.

## Problem 1 — Icons mushing into the text

Look at the screenshot: the icon is sitting *on top of* the first letter of the text. The `Padding.Left = 44` on a WinForms Flat button does **not** push the text past the image — it just clips the content region, so the image and text overlap.

**WinForms buttons with image + text are notoriously awkward.** `ImageAlign = MiddleLeft` positions the image at the left edge of the *padding region*, and `TextAlign = MiddleLeft` positions the text at the left edge of the *same* region. They don't automatically sequence.

**The reliable fix: use `TextImageRelation = TextImageRelation.ImageBeforeText`.**

That property, combined with `TextAlign` and `ImageAlign`, is the one thing that actually puts the image before the text with a gap. Then a small left padding pushes the whole pair in from the button's edge.

**Change in `CreateNavButton`:**

```csharp
var btn = new Button
{
    Text = text,
    Size = new Size(width, height),
    FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
    // TextImageRelation is what actually sequences [icon] [text] with a gap.
    TextImageRelation = TextImageRelation.ImageBeforeText,
    TextAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
    ImageAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft,
    // A modest left inset for the whole icon+text pair; the internal gap between
    // them is handled by WinForms once TextImageRelation is set.
    Padding = new Padding(12, 0, 0, 0),
    Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(10f),
    Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
    BackColor = BrandPalette.NavBackground,
    ForeColor = BrandPalette.NavText,
    Image = LoadIcon(iconFile),
};
```

**Key change: `Padding.Left = 12`** (down from 44) **and `TextImageRelation = TextImageRelation.ImageBeforeText` added.** The 12px is just the overall inset from the button's left edge. The gap between icon and text is then automatic (~6-8px).

That should render cleanly as `[12px] [icon 24px] [gap] [text...]`.

## Problem 2 — App icon (taskbar, title bar) not showing

You converted `fourtyeeight.ico` and `sixteeen.ico` but didn't wire them into the `.csproj`. Without that, the app uses the default .NET icon.

**Fix — edit `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.csproj`.**

Find the `<PropertyGroup>` block at the top:

```xml
<PropertyGroup>
  <OutputType>WinExe</OutputType>
  <TargetFramework>net10.0-windows</TargetFramework>
  <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  <UseWindowsForms>true</UseWindowsForms>
  <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
</PropertyGroup>
```

**Add one line:**

```xml
<PropertyGroup>
  <OutputType>WinExe</OutputType>
  <TargetFramework>net10.0-windows</TargetFramework>
  <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  <UseWindowsForms>true</UseWindowsForms>
  <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  <ApplicationIcon>Resources\Branding\fourtyeeight.ico</ApplicationIcon>
</PropertyGroup>
```

**What this does:** tells the compiler to embed that `.ico` as the executable's icon. Windows then shows it:

- In the taskbar (when the app is running).
- In the title bar (top-left of the window).
- In Alt+Tab.
- In File Explorer when you look at the .exe file.

**One caveat:** the `.ico` needs to be **on disk at the path relative to the `.csproj`** when the project builds. `Resources\Branding\fourtyeeight.ico` from `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.csproj` resolves to `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms/Resources/Branding/fourtyeeight.ico`. Confirm that's where the file is.

**Also:** `FrmMain` has a `Text = "Morcaffein CRM — Staff Console"` (in the Designer). The **title bar** icon comes from the app icon automatically once `<ApplicationIcon>` is set. But **each form has its own `Icon` property** that can override it. `FrmMain` and `FrmLogin` are currently using the default. If after setting `<ApplicationIcon>` the title bar still shows the wrong icon, we need to also set `this.Icon = ...` in each Form's constructor. **But** usually `<ApplicationIcon>` is enough — the default form icon falls back to the executable's icon.

**Try `<ApplicationIcon>` first.** If the title bar still shows wrong, tell me and I'll add the per-form icon load.

## Where else the icon should show up

**Taskbar:** shows the `ApplicationIcon` for the running exe. Should work once `<ApplicationIcon>` is set.

**Top-left of the app window (title bar):** same. Should work.

**Alt+Tab:** same.

**`FrmLogin` window:** should also inherit, but if it's a dialog with its own icon set, it might not. We'll see.

If Admin can't create another Admin, and SuperAdmin has no UI, then **new Admins can only be created by manual DB insertion.** That's fine, but I want to confirm the boundary:

**My read of what you're saying:** Admin cannot *create* new Admins, and cannot *edit anyone's role to or from Admin*. The role field in the edit form should probably just not show "Admin" as an option for non-SuperAdmin callers — or if it does, editing to/from Admin is blocked server-side.

**Two ways to handle this:**

**A. Hide "Admin" from the role dropdown entirely** for the Admin's edit form. Admin sees Barista and Manager as options only. Can't promote to Admin, can't demote an existing Admin (that role isn't in the dropdown).

**B. Show "Admin" as an option but block server-side** if the caller isn't SuperAdmin. More permissive but with server enforcement.

**My recommendation: A.** Simpler, and consistent — the Admin just doesn't see Admin as a role option. Since SuperAdmin has no UI, changing an employee's role *to* or *from* Admin has to happen via SQL, which is honest.

**Confirm A.**

Also: **what about editing an existing Admin's non-role fields?** Can Admin edit an Admin's name/contact/email? Or are Admin accounts entirely off-limits from the Admin UI?

**My recommendation: Admin can view other Admin accounts but can't edit them** (name, contact, role — all locked). Admin can edit Barista and Manager accounts freely.

**Confirm.**

## Clarification 2 — Forgot password on login

You said: *"password reset yes but that means forgot password is a function in login"*

That's a bigger feature than just resetting a password from the Admin UI. Let me lay out what "forgot password" actually means:

**Full forgot-password flow:**

1. User clicks "Forgot password?" on `FrmLogin`.
2. Enters their username or email.
3. Server checks if the account exists. If yes, generates a **reset token** (a one-time code, valid for N minutes).
4. **Sends the token via email or SMS** — this is where the notification layer we deferred earlier comes in.
5. User enters the token + new password.
6. Server verifies the token, updates the password, invalidates the token.

**This requires:**

- A `PasswordResetToken` table (or a `PasswordResetToken` column on the Credential row).
- A notification provider (email or SMS) — **which we deferred.**
- A "forgot password" form on the login screen.
- A "verify token" form.
- Server endpoints: `POST /auth/forgot-password`, `POST /auth/reset-password`.

**That's a real feature area, not a small addition.** And it's blocked on the notification layer, which we deferred.

**Two paths:**

**A. Include the full forgot-password flow now.**

- Builds the reset token infrastructure.
- Requires at minimum a *stub* notification (logs the token to a file, so you can manually copy it during testing).
- Adds maybe a few hours of work.

**B. Only do "Admin resets user password" now** (from the Manage Users UI — Admin sets a new password directly, no email involved). Defer the self-service forgot-password flow until after SMS/Email is built.

**My strong recommendation: B.** The Admin-reset flow is what you actually asked for in Q4 ("password reset yes"). Self-service "forgot password" from login is a different, larger feature that logically belongs with SMS/Email — and you already decided SMS/Email is second-to-last.

**If you want B:** Admin clicks "Reset Password" on an employee in Manage Users → a small dialog opens → Admin types a new password → server hashes it and saves → done. No email, no token, no login-screen form.

**If you want A:** we do the whole flow now, with a stub notifier that writes the reset link to a file.

**Which — A or B?**

2. **Password reset scope:** A (full forgot-password flow now) or B (Admin-only reset now, forgot-password later)?

```csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.domain.entities;
using CRM_Morcaffein.infrastructure.services;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.api.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Authorize]   // any authenticated employee can hit this controller...
    [Route("api/tenant/{companyId:int}/employees")]
    public class EmployeesController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly ITenantDbContextFactory _tenantFactory;

        public EmployeesController(ITenantDbContextFactory tenantFactory)
        {
            _tenantFactory = tenantFactory;
        }

        // ---- helpers ----

        private int GetCallerEmployeeId()
        {
            var claim = User.FindFirst("employeeId")?.Value
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing employeeId claim.");
            return int.Parse(claim);
        }

        private bool CallerIsAdmin() => User.IsInRole("Admin") || User.IsInRole("SuperAdmin");

        private void ForbidIfNotAdmin()
        {
            if (!CallerIsAdmin())
                throw new UnauthorizedAccessException();
        }

        // ---- endpoints ----

        // GET api/tenant/{companyId}/employees?search=&page=1&pageSize=25
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<ActionResult<PagedResponse<EmployeeResponseDto>>> GetEmployees(
            int companyId,
            [FromQuery] string? search,
            [FromQuery] int page = 1,
            [FromQuery] int pageSize = 25)
        {
            if (!CallerIsAdmin())
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only admins can manage employees." });

            if (page < 1) page = 1;
            if (pageSize < 1) pageSize = 25;
            if (pageSize > 200) pageSize = 200;

            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            var query = tenant.Employees
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(e => e.Credential)
                .AsQueryable();

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
            {
                var term = search.Trim();
                query = query.Where(e =>
                    (e.FirstName + " " + e.LastName).Contains(term) ||
                    e.ContactNumber.Contains(term) ||
                    (e.Credential != null && e.Credential.Username.Contains(term)) ||
                    e.EmployeeId.ToString() == term);
            }

            var totalCount = await query.CountAsync();

            var items = await query
                .OrderBy(e => e.EmployeeId)
                .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .Select(e => new EmployeeResponseDto
                {
                    EmployeeId = e.EmployeeId,
                    FirstName = e.FirstName,
                    LastName = e.LastName,
                    FullName = (e.FirstName + " " + e.LastName).Trim(),
                    ContactNumber = e.ContactNumber,
                    Email = e.Email,
                    Role = e.Role,
                    IsActive = e.IsActive,
                    Username = e.Credential != null ? e.Credential.Username : null,
                    LastLoginDate = e.Credential != null ? e.Credential.LastLoginDate : null,
                    HasCredential = e.Credential != null
                })
                .ToListAsync();

            return Ok(new PagedResponse<EmployeeResponseDto>
            {
                Items = items,
                TotalCount = totalCount,
                Page = page,
                PageSize = pageSize
            });
        }

        // GET api/tenant/{companyId}/employees/{id}
        [HttpGet("{id:int}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<EmployeeResponseDto>> GetEmployee(int companyId, int id)
        {
            if (!CallerIsAdmin())
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only admins can manage employees." });

            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            var employee = await tenant.Employees
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(e => e.Credential)
                .Where(e => e.EmployeeId == id)
                .Select(e => new EmployeeResponseDto
                {
                    EmployeeId = e.EmployeeId,
                    FirstName = e.FirstName,
                    LastName = e.LastName,
                    FullName = (e.FirstName + " " + e.LastName).Trim(),
                    ContactNumber = e.ContactNumber,
                    Email = e.Email,
                    Role = e.Role,
                    IsActive = e.IsActive,
                    Username = e.Credential != null ? e.Credential.Username : null,
                    LastLoginDate = e.Credential != null ? e.Credential.LastLoginDate : null,
                    HasCredential = e.Credential != null
                })
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

            if (employee is null)
                return NotFound();

            return Ok(employee);
        }

        // POST api/tenant/{companyId}/employees
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<ActionResult<EmployeeResponseDto>> CreateEmployee(
            int companyId,
            CreateEmployeeRequest request)
        {
            if (!CallerIsAdmin())
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only admins can create employees." });

            // Validation
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.FirstName))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "First name is required." });
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.LastName))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Last name is required." });

            var cleanedPhone = new string((request.ContactNumber ?? "").Where(char.IsDigit).ToArray());
            if (cleanedPhone.Length < 10 || cleanedPhone.Length > 11)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Contact number must be 10-11 digits." });

            var cleanedEmail = string.Empty;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Email))
            {
                if (!request.Email.Contains('@') || !request.Email.Contains('.'))
                    return BadRequest(new { message = "Invalid email format." });
                cleanedEmail = request.Email.Trim().ToLower();
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Username) || request.Username.Trim().Length < 3)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Username must be at least 3 characters." });
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Password) || request.Password.Length < 4)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Password must be at least 4 characters." });

            // Role — Admin cannot create Admins
            var requestedRole = (request.Role ?? "Barista").Trim();
            if (requestedRole.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                requestedRole.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only the SuperAdmin can create Admin accounts." });
            }
            if (!requestedRole.Equals("Barista", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                !requestedRole.Equals("Manager", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Role must be Barista or Manager." });
            }

            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            // Uniqueness of username
            var usernameTaken = await tenant.Credentials
                .AnyAsync(c => c.Username == request.Username.Trim());
            if (usernameTaken)
                return Conflict(new { message = "That username is already taken." });

            var employee = new Employee
            {
                FirstName = request.FirstName.Trim(),
                LastName = request.LastName.Trim(),
                ContactNumber = cleanedPhone,
                Email = cleanedEmail,
                Role = requestedRole,
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            };

            var credential = new Credential
            {
                Username = request.Username.Trim(),
                PasswordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(request.Password),
                Employee = employee,
                FailedLoginAttempts = 0,
                IsLocked = false,
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            };

            tenant.Employees.Add(employee);
            tenant.Credentials.Add(credential);

            try
            {
                await tenant.SaveChangesAsync();
            }
            catch (DbUpdateException ex)
            {
                return Conflict(new { message = ex.InnerException?.Message ?? ex.Message });
            }

            return Ok(new EmployeeResponseDto
            {
                EmployeeId = employee.EmployeeId,
                FirstName = employee.FirstName,
                LastName = employee.LastName,
                FullName = employee.FullName,
                ContactNumber = employee.ContactNumber,
                Email = employee.Email,
                Role = employee.Role,
                IsActive = employee.IsActive,
                Username = credential.Username,
                LastLoginDate = credential.LastLoginDate,
                HasCredential = true
            });
        }

        // PUT api/tenant/{companyId}/employees/{id}
        [HttpPut("{id:int}")]
        public async Task<ActionResult<EmployeeResponseDto>> UpdateEmployee(
            int companyId,
            int id,
            UpdateEmployeeRequest request)
        {
            if (!CallerIsAdmin())
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only admins can update employees." });

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.FirstName))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "First name is required." });
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.LastName))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Last name is required." });

            var cleanedPhone = new string((request.ContactNumber ?? "").Where(char.IsDigit).ToArray());
            if (cleanedPhone.Length < 10 || cleanedPhone.Length > 11)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Contact number must be 10-11 digits." });

            var cleanedEmail = string.Empty;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Email))
            {
                if (!request.Email.Contains('@') || !request.Email.Contains('.'))
                    return BadRequest(new { message = "Invalid email format." });
                cleanedEmail = request.Email.Trim().ToLower();
            }

            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            var employee = await tenant.Employees.FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.EmployeeId == id);
            if (employee is null)
                return NotFound();

            // Guard: cannot edit an Admin's account
            if (employee.Role.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                employee.Role.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Admin accounts cannot be edited from this console." });

            // Guard: cannot change someone's role to Admin
            var requestedRole = (request.Role ?? "").Trim();
            if (requestedRole.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                requestedRole.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only the SuperAdmin can promote to Admin." });
            if (!requestedRole.Equals("Barista", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                !requestedRole.Equals("Manager", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Role must be Barista or Manager." });

            employee.FirstName = request.FirstName.Trim();
            employee.LastName = request.LastName.Trim();
            employee.ContactNumber = cleanedPhone;
            employee.Email = cleanedEmail;
            employee.Role = requestedRole;
            employee.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

            try
            {
                await tenant.SaveChangesAsync();
            }
            catch (DbUpdateException ex)
            {
                return Conflict(new { message = ex.InnerException?.Message ?? ex.Message });
            }

            var credential = await tenant.Credentials
                .AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.EmployeeId == employee.EmployeeId);

            return Ok(new EmployeeResponseDto
            {
                EmployeeId = employee.EmployeeId,
                FirstName = employee.FirstName,
                LastName = employee.LastName,
                FullName = employee.FullName,
                ContactNumber = employee.ContactNumber,
                Email = employee.Email,
                Role = employee.Role,
                IsActive = employee.IsActive,
                Username = credential?.Username,
                LastLoginDate = credential?.LastLoginDate,
                HasCredential = credential != null
            });
        }

        // POST api/tenant/{companyId}/employees/{id}/deactivate
        [HttpPost("{id:int}/deactivate")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeactivateEmployee(int companyId, int id)
        {
            if (!CallerIsAdmin())
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only admins can deactivate employees." });

            var callerId = GetCallerEmployeeId();
            if (callerId == id)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "You cannot deactivate your own account." });

            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            var employee = await tenant.Employees
                .Include(e => e.Credential)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.EmployeeId == id);
            if (employee is null)
                return NotFound();

            if (employee.Role.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                employee.Role.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Admin accounts cannot be deactivated from this console." });

            employee.IsActive = false;
            employee.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

            if (employee.Credential is not null)
            {
                employee.Credential.IsActive = false;
                employee.Credential.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            }

            try
            {
                await tenant.SaveChangesAsync();
            }
            catch (DbUpdateException ex)
            {
                return Conflict(new { message = ex.InnerException?.Message ?? ex.Message });
            }

            return NoContent();
        }

        // POST api/tenant/{companyId}/employees/{id}/reset-password
        [HttpPost("{id:int}/reset-password")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ResetPassword(
            int companyId,
            int id,
            ResetPasswordRequest request)
        {
            if (!CallerIsAdmin())
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only admins can reset passwords." });

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.NewPassword) || request.NewPassword.Length < 4)
                return BadRequest(new { message = "Password must be at least 4 characters." });

            await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

            var credential = await tenant.Credentials
                .Include(c => c.Employee)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.EmployeeId == id);

            if (credential is null)
                return NotFound(new { message = "This employee has no credential to reset." });

            if (credential.Employee is not null &&
                (credential.Employee.Role.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                 credential.Employee.Role.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Admin passwords cannot be reset from this console." });

            credential.PasswordHash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(request.NewPassword);
            credential.FailedLoginAttempts = 0;
            credential.IsLocked = false;
            credential.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

            try
            {
                await tenant.SaveChangesAsync();
            }
            catch (DbUpdateException ex)
            {
                return Conflict(new { message = ex.InnerException?.Message ?? ex.Message });
            }

            return NoContent();
        }
    }
}
```

**Notes on this controller:**

- `[Authorize]` on the class means any authenticated user can *reach* the endpoint — but every action then checks `CallerIsAdmin()` and returns 403 if the caller isn't Admin/SuperAdmin. (Why both? `[Authorize(Roles="Admin")]` on the class would work too, but the explicit check gives us a nicer error message and consistent handling.)
- The JWT claims carry `employeeId` and role — I read them via `User.FindFirst("employeeId")` and `User.IsInRole(...)`. **For `User.IsInRole` to work, the JWT's role claim must use the standard claim type.** In `JwtTokenService.cs`, you're using `new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, employee.Role)`. That's correct — `ClaimTypes.Role` maps to what `IsInRole` reads.
- **Guards:**
  - Admin can create only Barista or Manager roles. Attempting Admin/SuperAdmin → 403.
  - Admin can't edit someone whose current role is Admin/SuperAdmin.
  - Admin can't change someone's role *to* Admin/SuperAdmin.
  - Admin can't deactivate themselves.
  - Admin can't deactivate another Admin.
  - Admin can't reset another Admin's password.
- **Reset password unlocks the account** — clears `FailedLoginAttempts` and `IsLocked`. That's the sensible behavior (the whole point of a reset is often because someone got locked out).

## File 6 — `CRM_Morcaffein.winforms/Services/Api/EmployeeApi.cs`

```csharp
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services.Api
{
    public class EmployeeApi
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _http;

        public EmployeeApi()
        {
            _http = ApiClientFactory.Create();
        }

        public async Task<PagedResponse<EmployeeResponseDto>> GetEmployeesAsync(
            string? search = null, int page = 1, int pageSize = 25)
        {
            var url = $"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/employees?page={page}&pageSize={pageSize}";
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
                url += $"&search={Uri.EscapeDataString(search)}";

            var response = await _http.GetAsync(url);
            await EnsureSuccess(response);

            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<PagedResponse<EmployeeResponseDto>>();
            return result ?? new PagedResponse<EmployeeResponseDto>();
        }

        public async Task<EmployeeResponseDto?> GetEmployeeAsync(int employeeId)
        {
            var response = await _http.GetAsync($"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/employees/{employeeId}");
            if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.NotFound) return null;
            await EnsureSuccess(response);
            return await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<EmployeeResponseDto>();
        }

        public async Task<EmployeeResponseDto> CreateEmployeeAsync(CreateEmployeeRequest request)
        {
            var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync(
                $"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/employees", request);
            await EnsureSuccess(response);
            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<EmployeeResponseDto>();
            return result ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("API returned an empty employee.");
        }

        public async Task<EmployeeResponseDto> UpdateEmployeeAsync(int employeeId, UpdateEmployeeRequest request)
        {
            var response = await _http.PutAsJsonAsync(
                $"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/employees/{employeeId}", request);
            await EnsureSuccess(response);
            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<EmployeeResponseDto>();
            return result ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("API returned an empty employee.");
        }

        public async Task DeactivateEmployeeAsync(int employeeId)
        {
            var response = await _http.PostAsync(
                $"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/employees/{employeeId}/deactivate", null);
            await EnsureSuccess(response);
        }

        public async Task ResetPasswordAsync(int employeeId, string newPassword)
        {
            var body = new ResetPasswordRequest { NewPassword = newPassword };
            var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync(
                $"api/tenant/{ApiConfig.CompanyId}/employees/{employeeId}/reset-password", body);
            await EnsureSuccess(response);
        }

        private static async Task EnsureSuccess(HttpResponseMessage response)
        {
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode) return;
            var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            var message = TryExtractMessage(body) ?? $"API returned {(int)response.StatusCode}.";
            throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
        }

        private static string? TryExtractMessage(string body)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(body)) return null;
            const string marker = "\"message\":\"";
            var idx = body.IndexOf(marker, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (idx < 0) return null;
            var start = idx + marker.Length;
            var end = body.IndexOf('"', start);
            if (end < 0) return null;
            return body.Substring(start, end - start);
        }
    }
}
```

**Note:** I used `ApiClientFactory.Create()` since that's what the other Api classes use (and it attaches the JWT). If you didn't keep `ApiClientFactory` around, tell me — I'll switch to `new HttpClient { BaseAddress = ... }` and duplicate the header attachment. But since you've been using it consistently, I assume it's still there.

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.api.DTOs;
using CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Services.Api;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers
{
    public class EmployeeController
    {
        private readonly EmployeeApi _api;

        public EmployeeController()
        {
            _api = new EmployeeApi();
        }

        public Task<PagedResponse<EmployeeResponseDto>> SearchAsync(string searchText, int page = 1, int pageSize = 25)
            => _api.GetEmployeesAsync(searchText, page, pageSize);

        public Task<EmployeeResponseDto?> GetByIdAsync(int employeeId)
            => _api.GetEmployeeAsync(employeeId);

        public Task<EmployeeResponseDto> CreateAsync(
            string firstName, string lastName, string phone, string? email,
            string role, string username, string password)
        {
            var request = new CreateEmployeeRequest
            {
                FirstName = firstName,
                LastName = lastName,
                ContactNumber = phone,
                Email = email,
                Role = role,
                Username = username,
                Password = password,
            };
            return _api.CreateEmployeeAsync(request);
        }

        public Task<EmployeeResponseDto> UpdateAsync(
            int employeeId, string firstName, string lastName, string phone,
            string? email, string role)
        {
            var request = new UpdateEmployeeRequest
            {
                FirstName = firstName,
                LastName = lastName,
                ContactNumber = phone,
                Email = email,
                Role = role,
            };
            return _api.UpdateEmployeeAsync(employeeId, request);
        }

        public Task DeactivateAsync(int employeeId) => _api.DeactivateEmployeeAsync(employeeId);

        public Task ResetPasswordAsync(int employeeId, string newPassword) =>
            _api.ResetPasswordAsync(employeeId, newPassword);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Theme;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views
{
    public class FrmResetPassword : Form
    {
        private readonly EmployeeController _controller;
        private readonly int _employeeId;
        private readonly string _employeeName;

        private TextBox _newPasswordTxtBx = null!;
        private TextBox _confirmPasswordTxtBx = null!;
        private Label _errorLabel = null!;

        public FrmResetPassword(EmployeeController controller, int employeeId, string employeeName)
        {
            _controller = controller;
            _employeeId = employeeId;
            _employeeName = employeeName;

            Text = "Reset Password";
            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog;
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent;
            MaximizeBox = false;
            MinimizeBox = false;
            ClientSize = new Size(400, 300);
            BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f);
            Padding = new Padding(24);

            BuildLayout();
        }

        private void BuildLayout()
        {
            var title = new Label
            {
                Text = $"Reset password for {_employeeName}",
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 30,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(11f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText,
            };

            var hint = new Label
            {
                Text = "Enter a new password. The employee will use this on next login.",
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 40,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
            };

            _newPasswordTxtBx = new TextBox
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(10f),
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
                UseSystemPasswordChar = true,
                PlaceholderText = "New password (min 4 chars)",
            };

            var spacer1 = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 12 };

            _confirmPasswordTxtBx = new TextBox
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(10f),
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
                UseSystemPasswordChar = true,
                PlaceholderText = "Confirm new password",
            };

            var spacer2 = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 12 };

            _errorLabel = new Label
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 30,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill,
            };

            var btnRow = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Bottom, Height = 44 };

            var cancelBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Cancel",
                Width = 120,
                Height = 36,
                Dock = DockStyle.Right,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            cancelBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            cancelBtn.Click += (s, e) => { DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel; Close(); };

            var confirmBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Reset Password",
                Width = 140,
                Height = 36,
                Dock = DockStyle.Right,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            confirmBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            confirmBtn.Click += ConfirmBtn_Click;

            // Add Right-docked in reverse order: last added ends up leftmost.
            btnRow.Controls.Add(cancelBtn);
            btnRow.Controls.Add(confirmBtn);

            Controls.Add(btnRow);
            Controls.Add(_errorLabel);
            Controls.Add(spacer2);
            Controls.Add(_confirmPasswordTxtBx);
            Controls.Add(spacer1);
            Controls.Add(_newPasswordTxtBx);
            Controls.Add(hint);
            Controls.Add(title);

            _newPasswordTxtBx.TabIndex = 0;
            _confirmPasswordTxtBx.TabIndex = 1;
            confirmBtn.TabIndex = 2;
            cancelBtn.TabIndex = 3;
            AcceptButton = confirmBtn;
            CancelButton = cancelBtn;
        }

        private async void ConfirmBtn_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            var pwd = _newPasswordTxtBx.Text;
            var confirm = _confirmPasswordTxtBx.Text;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pwd) || pwd.Length < 4)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Password must be at least 4 characters.";
                return;
            }
            if (pwd != confirm)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Passwords do not match.";
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                await _controller.ResetPasswordAsync(_employeeId, pwd);
                MessageBox.Show(this, "Password has been reset.", "Success",
                    MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Information);
                DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
                Close();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = ex.Message;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers;

        private static Button MakeActionButton(string text, int y)

        private static void ConfigureGrid(DataGridView grid)
        {
            grid.BackgroundColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            grid.AllowUserToAddRows = false;
            grid.AllowUserToDeleteRows = false;
            grid.AllowUserToResizeRows = false;
            grid.ReadOnly = true;
            grid.RowHeadersVisible = false;
            grid.MultiSelect = false;
            grid.SelectionMode = DataGridViewSelectionMode.FullRowSelect;
            grid.AutoGenerateColumns = false;
            grid.EnableHeadersVisualStyles = false;
            grid.GridColor = BrandPalette.Border;
            grid.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f);
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.BackColor = BrandPalette.HeaderBackground;
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = BrandPalette.HeaderText;
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9.5f);
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = BrandPalette.HeaderBackground;
            grid.ColumnHeadersDefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = BrandPalette.HeaderText;
            grid.ColumnHeadersHeight = 36;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor = BrandPalette.RowSelected;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.SelectionForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            grid.DefaultCellStyle.ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText;
            grid.RowTemplate.Height = 30;
            grid.ScrollBars = ScrollBars.Vertical;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // LOADING
        // =====================================================================

        private async Task ReloadAsync(bool keepPage = false)
        {
            if (!keepPage)
            {
                _page = 1;
                pagination.ResetToFirstPage();
            }

            PagedResponse<EmployeeResponseDto> response;
            try
            {
                response = await _controller.SearchAsync(searchTxtBx.Text, _page, PageSize);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(FindForm(), ex.Message, "Error loading employees");
                return;
            }

            _employeesBindingSource.DataSource = response.Items;
            employeesGrid.DataSource = _employeesBindingSource;
            pagination.UpdatePageInfo(response.TotalCount, response.Page, response.PageSize);

            employeesGrid.ClearSelection();
            try { employeesGrid.CurrentCell = null; } catch { }
            _selectedEmployee = null;
            RefreshDrawer();
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // DRAWER
        // =====================================================================

        private void RefreshDrawer()
        {
            var emp = _selectedEmployee;
            if (emp is null)
            {
                drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = true;
                drawerContentPanel.Visible = false;
                return;
            }

            drawerEmptyLabel.Visible = false;
            drawerContentPanel.Visible = true;

            nameLabel.Text = emp.FullName;
            roleLabel.Text = $"{emp.Role}";
            contactLabel.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(emp.ContactNumber) ? "—" : emp.ContactNumber;
            usernameLabel.Text = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(emp.Username) ? "No login" : $"Login: {emp.Username}";
            lastLoginLabel.Text = emp.LastLoginDate.HasValue
                ? $"Last login: {emp.LastLoginDate.Value:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}"
                : "Never logged in";
            statusLabel.Text = emp.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive";
            statusLabel.ForeColor = emp.IsActive ? BrandPalette.StatusPositiveText : BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill;

            // The server blocks editing/deactivating Admin accounts. Grey out the buttons for that case.
            var isAdminRow = emp.Role.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                             emp.Role.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            editBtn.Enabled = !isAdminRow;
            resetPasswordBtn.Enabled = !isAdminRow;
            deactivateBtn.Enabled = !isAdminRow && emp.IsActive;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // ACTIONS
        // =====================================================================

        private void OpenCreateModal()
        {
            using var form = new FrmCreateEmployee(_controller);
            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                _ = ReloadAsync();
            }
        }

        private void OpenEditModal()
        {
            if (_selectedEmployee is null) return;

            using var form = new FrmEditEmployee(_controller, _selectedEmployee);
            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                _ = ReloadAsync(keepPage: true);
            }
        }

        private void OpenResetPasswordModal()
        {
            if (_selectedEmployee is null) return;

            using var form = new FrmResetPassword(_controller, _selectedEmployee.EmployeeId, _selectedEmployee.FullName);
            if (form.ShowDialog(FindForm()) == DialogResult.OK)
            {
                // no grid refresh needed
            }
        }

        private async void DeactivateSelected()
        {
            if (_selectedEmployee is null) return;

            var confirm = MessageBox.Show(FindForm(),
                $"Deactivate {_selectedEmployee.FullName}? They will no longer be able to log in.",
                "Deactivate Employee",
                MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
                MessageBoxIcon.Warning);

            if (confirm != DialogResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                await _controller.DeactivateAsync(_selectedEmployee.EmployeeId);
                await ReloadAsync(keepPage: true);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(FindForm(), ex.Message, "Deactivate failed");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using CRM_Morcaffein.Controllers;
using CRM_Morcaffein.Theme;

namespace CRM_Morcaffein.winforms.Views
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Modal for creating a new employee + their login credential in one step.
    /// Admin can only assign Barista or Manager roles — the server enforces the same
    /// rule, but we also omit "Admin" from the dropdown here.
    /// </summary>
    public class FrmCreateEmployee : Form
    {
        private readonly EmployeeController _controller;

        private TextBox _firstNameTxtBx = null!;
        private TextBox _lastNameTxtBx = null!;
        private TextBox _contactTxtBx = null!;
        private TextBox _emailTxtBx = null!;
        private ComboBox _roleCombo = null!;
        private TextBox _usernameTxtBx = null!;
        private TextBox _passwordTxtBx = null!;
        private TextBox _confirmTxtBx = null!;
        private Label _errorLabel = null!;

        public FrmCreateEmployee(EmployeeController controller)
        {
            _controller = controller;

            Text = "New Employee";
            FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog;
            StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent;
            MaximizeBox = false;
            MinimizeBox = false;
            ClientSize = new Size(500, 560);
            BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary;
            Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f);
            Padding = new Padding(24);

            BuildLayout();
        }

        private void BuildLayout()
        {
            var titleLabel = new Label
            {
                Text = "Create Employee",
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 30,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(14f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralText,
            };

            var subtitleLabel = new Label
            {
                Text = "Fill in the employee's details and assign them a login.",
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 40,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
            };

            // Two-column row for first/last name
            var nameRow = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 68 };
            _firstNameTxtBx = MakeField("First name *", nameRow, 0, 0, 220);
            _lastNameTxtBx = MakeField("Last name *", nameRow, 244, 0, 220);

            _contactTxtBx = MakeField("Contact number * (10-11 digits)", null, 0, 0, 464);
            _contactTxtBx.KeyPress += (s, e) =>
            {
                if (!char.IsControl(e.KeyChar) && !char.IsDigit(e.KeyChar))
                    e.Handled = true;
            };
            var contactPanel = WrapField("Contact number * (10-11 digits)", _contactTxtBx, 68);

            _emailTxtBx = MakeField("Email (optional)", null, 0, 0, 464);
            var emailPanel = WrapField("Email (optional)", _emailTxtBx, 68);

            // Role row
            var rolePanel = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 68 };
            var roleLabel = new Label
            {
                Text = "Role *",
                Location = new Point(0, 0),
                AutoSize = true,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
            };
            _roleCombo = new ComboBox
            {
                Location = new Point(0, 20),
                Size = new Size(464, 28),
                DropDownStyle = ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
            };
            _roleCombo.Items.AddRange(new object[] { "Barista", "Manager" });
            _roleCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            rolePanel.Controls.Add(_roleCombo);
            rolePanel.Controls.Add(roleLabel);

            _usernameTxtBx = MakeField("Username * (min 3 chars)", null, 0, 0, 464);
            var usernamePanel = WrapField("Username * (min 3 chars)", _usernameTxtBx, 68);

            _passwordTxtBx = MakeField("Password * (min 4 chars)", null, 0, 0, 464);
            _passwordTxtBx.UseSystemPasswordChar = true;
            var passwordPanel = WrapField("Password * (min 4 chars)", _passwordTxtBx, 68);

            _confirmTxtBx = MakeField("Confirm password *", null, 0, 0, 464);
            _confirmTxtBx.UseSystemPasswordChar = true;
            var confirmPanel = WrapField("Confirm password *", _confirmTxtBx, 68);

            _errorLabel = new Label
            {
                Dock = DockStyle.Top,
                Height = 30,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(8.5f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill,
            };

            var btnRow = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Bottom, Height = 44 };

            var cancelBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Cancel",
                Width = 120,
                Height = 36,
                Dock = DockStyle.Right,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonSecondaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            cancelBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            cancelBtn.Click += (s, e) => { DialogResult = DialogResult.Cancel; Close(); };

            var createBtn = new Button
            {
                Text = "Create Employee",
                Width = 160,
                Height = 36,
                Dock = DockStyle.Right,
                FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
                BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryFill,
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryText,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontBold(9.5f),
                Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            };
            createBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
            createBtn.Click += CreateBtn_Click;

            btnRow.Controls.Add(cancelBtn);
            btnRow.Controls.Add(createBtn);

            // Build top-down. Order matters with Dock.Top: first added is bottom-most.
            // We want visual order: title, subtitle, first/last row, contact, email, role, username, password, confirm, error.
            var stack = new List<Control>
            {
                _errorLabel,
                confirmPanel,
                passwordPanel,
                usernamePanel,
                rolePanel,
                emailPanel,
                contactPanel,
                nameRow,
                subtitleLabel,
                titleLabel,
            };
            foreach (var c in stack)
                Controls.Add(c);
            Controls.Add(btnRow);

            // Tab order
            int tab = 0;
            _firstNameTxtBx.TabIndex = tab++;
            _lastNameTxtBx.TabIndex = tab++;
            _contactTxtBx.TabIndex = tab++;
            _emailTxtBx.TabIndex = tab++;
            _roleCombo.TabIndex = tab++;
            _usernameTxtBx.TabIndex = tab++;
            _passwordTxtBx.TabIndex = tab++;
            _confirmTxtBx.TabIndex = tab++;
            createBtn.TabIndex = tab++;
            cancelBtn.TabIndex = tab++;

            AcceptButton = createBtn;
            CancelButton = cancelBtn;
        }

        private static TextBox MakeField(string _, Panel parent, int x, int y, int width)
        {
            return new TextBox
            {
                Location = new Point(x, y + 20),
                Size = new Size(width, 28),
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
                BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
            };
        }

        private static Panel WrapField(string labelText, TextBox field, int height)
        {
            var panel = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = height };
            var label = new Label
            {
                Text = labelText,
                Location = new Point(0, 0),
                AutoSize = true,
                Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
                ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
            };
            panel.Controls.Add(field);
            panel.Controls.Add(label);
            return panel;
        }

        private async void CreateBtn_Click(object? sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _errorLabel.Text = string.Empty;

            // Client-side validation matching server rules
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_firstNameTxtBx.Text) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_lastNameTxtBx.Text))
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "First and last name are required.";
                return;
            }

            var cleanedPhone = new string(_contactTxtBx.Text.Where(char.IsDigit).ToArray());
            if (cleanedPhone.Length < 10 || cleanedPhone.Length > 11)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Contact number must be 10-11 digits.";
                return;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_emailTxtBx.Text) &&
                (!_emailTxtBx.Text.Contains('@') || !_emailTxtBx.Text.Contains('.')))
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Invalid email format.";
                return;
            }

            if (_usernameTxtBx.Text.Trim().Length < 3)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Username must be at least 3 characters.";
                return;
            }

            if (_passwordTxtBx.Text.Length < 4)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Password must be at least 4 characters.";
                return;
            }

            if (_passwordTxtBx.Text != _confirmTxtBx.Text)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = "Passwords do not match.";
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                await _controller.CreateAsync(
                    _firstNameTxtBx.Text, _lastNameTxtBx.Text,
                    _contactTxtBx.Text,
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_emailTxtBx.Text) ? null : _emailTxtBx.Text,
                    _roleCombo.SelectedItem as string ?? "Barista",
                    _usernameTxtBx.Text,
                    _passwordTxtBx.Text);

                DialogResult = DialogResult.OK;
                Close();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _errorLabel.Text = ex.Message;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Note about a couple of details in the modals

**`MakeField` in `FrmCreateEmployee`:** I passed unused parameters (`Panel parent`, `int y`, `string _`) that aren't used. That's sloppy. But it compiles — parameters being unused is just a warning, not an error. If you want it clean, replace `MakeField` calls with the direct construction pattern (like `FrmEditEmployee` uses). **Not a blocker.** Tell me if you want it cleaned up.

**`FrmEditEmployee` uses `_employee.Role` preselect:** if the role is somehow "Admin" (shouldn't be, since the drawer disables editing for admin accounts), `_roleCombo.Items.IndexOf("Admin")` returns -1, and it defaults to "Barista". The server would reject the update anyway. Guarding client-side is redundant but harmless.

## Issue 1 — Deactivated employee doesn't gray out in the grid

You confirmed "it deactivates but don't gray out." The grid displays `IsActive` as a column value ("Active" / "Inactive"), but the row itself doesn't visually change. Right now, a deactivated employee is `IsActive = false` in the DB, but the grid renders them identically to active employees.

**Fix:** in `ManageUsersView`, add a `CellFormatting` handler on `employeesGrid` that:

- Grays out the entire row (fore color muted, maybe light gray background) when `IsActive == false`.
- Optionally renders the "Active" column as "Yes / No" or "Active / Inactive" text.

**Concrete fix — add to the grid setup:**

```csharp
employeesGrid.CellFormatting += EmployeesGrid_CellFormatting;
```

And the handler:

```csharp
private void EmployeesGrid_CellFormatting(object? sender, DataGridViewCellFormattingEventArgs e)
{
    if (employeesGrid.Rows[e.RowIndex].DataBoundItem is not EmployeeResponseDto emp)
        return;

    // Format the IsActive column as Active/Inactive
    if (employeesGrid.Columns[e.ColumnIndex].Name == nameof(EmployeeResponseDto.IsActive))
    {
        e.Value = emp.IsActive ? "Active" : "Inactive";
        e.FormattingApplied = true;
    }

    // Gray out the entire row for deactivated employees
    if (!emp.IsActive)
    {
        e.CellStyle.ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted;
        e.CellStyle.BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfaceSecondary;
    }
}
```

**What this does:** deactivated rows get a muted text color and slightly tinted background, so they read as "disabled" at a glance.

**One caveat:** the `DefaultCellStyle.SelectionBackColor` might override the background when the row is selected. If selected-row behavior gets weird, we can also set `e.CellStyle.SelectionBackColor` — but try this first.

**The textbox is created but never added to `parent`.** That's the bug — `MakeField` returns the textbox but doesn't call `parent.Controls.Add(textbox)`. So the textboxes exist as variables but aren't in any panel, hence not rendered.

## Design decision first

**The drawer currently has three buttons: Edit Details / Reset Password / Deactivate Employee.**

When an employee is **active**, the Deactivate button is enabled. When they're **inactive**, Deactivate is disabled (from the `RefreshDrawer` logic — `deactivateBtn.Enabled = !isAdminRow && emp.IsActive;`).

**Two ways to add Reactivate:**

**A. Make the Deactivate button toggle.** When the employee is active → button says "Deactivate Employee". When inactive → button says "Reactivate Employee". Same button, changes label and behavior based on state.

**B. Add a fourth button.** Edit / Reset Password / Deactivate / Reactivate. Both always present; one is disabled depending on state.

**My recommendation: A.** Cleaner UX — one button, one purpose, label reflects state. Fewer buttons in the drawer. This is the standard pattern.

## Edit 1 — `CRM_Morcaffein.api/Controllers/EmployeesController.cs`

Add this new endpoint. Place it right after the `DeactivateEmployee` method.

```csharp
// POST api/tenant/{companyId}/employees/{id}/reactivate
[HttpPost("{id:int}/reactivate")]
public async Task<IActionResult> ReactivateEmployee(int companyId, int id)
{
    if (!CallerIsAdmin())
        return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Only admins can reactivate employees." });

    await using var tenant = await _tenantFactory.CreateAsync(companyId);

    var employee = await tenant.Employees
        .Include(e => e.Credential)
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(e => e.EmployeeId == id);

    if (employee is null)
        return NotFound();

    if (employee.Role.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        employee.Role.Equals("SuperAdmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        return StatusCode(403, new { message = "Admin accounts cannot be reactivated from this console." });

    employee.IsActive = true;
    employee.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

    if (employee.Credential is not null)
    {
        employee.Credential.IsActive = true;
        employee.Credential.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    try
    {
        await tenant.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
    catch (DbUpdateException ex)
    {
        return Conflict(new { message = ex.InnerException?.Message ?? ex.Message });
    }

    return NoContent();
}
```

**Note:** reactivation also clears the lock (`IsLocked = false`) and `FailedLoginAttempts = 0` on the credential? **No** — that's what Reset Password does. Reactivation just un-hides the account. The credential is unlocked by a password reset, not by reactivation. Keep them separate.

```csharp
private async void DeactivateSelected()
{
    if (_selectedEmployee is null) return;

    var emp = _selectedEmployee;
    var activating = !emp.IsActive;

    var confirm = MessageBox.Show(FindForm(),
        activating
            ? $"Reactivate {emp.FullName}? They will be able to log in again."
            : $"Deactivate {emp.FullName}? They will no longer be able to log in.",
        activating ? "Reactivate Employee" : "Deactivate Employee",
        MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,
        MessageBoxIcon.Question);

    if (confirm != DialogResult.Yes) return;

    try
    {
        if (activating)
            await _controller.ReactivateAsync(emp.EmployeeId);
        else
            await _controller.DeactivateAsync(emp.EmployeeId);

        await ReloadAsync(keepPage: true);
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        MessageBox.Show(FindForm(), ex.Message, activating ? "Reactivate failed" : "Deactivate failed");
    }
}
```

```csharp
    // Divider line between profile info and buttons
    var dividerLine = new Panel
    {
        Location = new Point(16, 186),
        Size = new Size(308, 1),
        BackColor = BrandPalette.Border,
    };

    // Action buttons — start below the divider
    editBtn = MakeActionButton("Edit Details", 206);
    editBtn.Click += (s, e) => OpenEditModal();

    resetPasswordBtn = MakeActionButton("Reset Password", 248);
    resetPasswordBtn.Click += (s, e) => OpenResetPasswordModal();

    deactivateBtn = MakeActionButton("Deactivate Employee", 290);
    deactivateBtn.ForeColor = BrandPalette.StatusNegativeFill;
    deactivateBtn.Click += (s, e) => DeactivateSelected();

    combinedBox.Controls.Add(deactivateBtn);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(resetPasswordBtn);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(editBtn);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(dividerLine);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(statusLabel);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(lastLoginLabel);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(usernameLabel);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(contactLabel);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(roleLabel);
    combinedBox.Controls.Add(nameLabel);

    drawerFlow.Controls.Add(combinedBox);
    drawerContentPanel.Controls.Add(drawerFlow);

    drawerPanel.Controls.Add(drawerEmptyLabel);
    drawerPanel.Controls.Add(drawerContentPanel);

    // ---------- RIGHT SIDE: card with grid ----------
    var cardOuter = new Panel
    {
        Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
        BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfaceSecondary,
        Padding = new Padding(24),
    };

    var card = new Panel
    {
        Dock = DockStyle.Fill,
        BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary,
        BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
    };

    cardHeaderPanel = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 60, BackColor = BrandPalette.SurfacePrimary };

    searchTxtBx = new TextBox
    {
        Location = new Point(16, 16),
        Size = new Size(300, 28),
        PlaceholderText = "Search by name, contact, username, or ID",
        Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(10f),
    };
    searchTxtBx.TextChanged += async (s, e) => await ReloadAsync();

    newEmployeeBtn = new Button
    {
        Text = "+ New Employee",
        Size = new Size(150, 32),
        Location = new Point(16, 14),
        FlatStyle = FlatStyle.Flat,
        BackColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryFill,
        ForeColor = BrandPalette.ButtonPrimaryText,
        Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
        Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
    };
    newEmployeeBtn.FlatAppearance.BorderSize = 0;
    newEmployeeBtn.Click += (s, e) => OpenCreateModal();

    var divider = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Bottom, Height = 1, BackColor = BrandPalette.Border };

    cardHeaderPanel.Controls.Add(newEmployeeBtn);
    cardHeaderPanel.Controls.Add(searchTxtBx);
    cardHeaderPanel.Controls.Add(divider);
    cardHeaderPanel.Resize += (s, e) =>
    {
        newEmployeeBtn.Left = cardHeaderPanel.ClientSize.Width - newEmployeeBtn.Width - 16;
        newEmployeeBtn.Top = 14;
    };

    pagination = new PaginationControl();
    pagination.PageChanged += async (s, page) =>
    {
        _page = page;
        await ReloadAsync(keepPage: true);
    };

    employeesGrid = new DataGridView { Dock = DockStyle.Fill, BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None };
    ConfigureGrid(employeesGrid);
    employeesGrid.CellFormatting += EmployeesGrid_CellFormatting;
    employeesGrid.SelectionChanged += async (s, e) =>
    {
        _selectedEmployee = employeesGrid.CurrentRow?.DataBoundItem as EmployeeResponseDto;
        RefreshDrawer();
    };

    card.Controls.Add(employeesGrid);
    card.Controls.Add(pagination);
    card.Controls.Add(cardHeaderPanel);
    cardOuter.Controls.Add(card);

    bodyPanel.Controls.Add(cardOuter);
    bodyPanel.Controls.Add(drawerPanel);
    Controls.Add(bodyPanel);

    // Initial position; also triggered on resize.
    newEmployeeBtn.Left = 300;
}
```

## What changed vs. the current version

- **Removed:** `profileBox` panel and `actionsBox` panel.
- **Removed:** the inner divider that used to sit between the two boxes (the gap used to be a `Margin` on the second box).
- **Added:** one `combinedBox` panel with `FixedSingle` border.
- **Added:** a thin divider line (1px) at Y=186 separating profile info from buttons.
- **Added:** direct `combinedBox.Controls.Add(...)` for all profile labels + buttons — no more two separate panels.
- **Kept:** `drawerFlow` unchanged (still hosts one child: `combinedBox`).
- **Kept:** `MakeActionButton` — the same helper that builds each button.

## One note on the divider

The `dividerLine` panel is at `Location = (16, 186)`, `Size = 308×1`. It spans the box's inner width. If your drawer feels cramped or the divider doesn't appear, we can adjust the Y.

# Change 4 — `FrmEditEmployee` missing First/Last name fields

The bug: `MakeField` returns a `TextBox` but never adds it to the parent panel, so the fields don't render. `FrmCreateEmployee` has the same bug on its name row. Both need fixing.

**Sequential — one file at a time.** Let's do **`FrmEditEmployee.cs`** first.

---

## The problem, in the current file

Look at `FrmEditEmployee.BuildLayout()`:

```csharp
var nameRow = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 68 };
_firstNameTxtBx = MakeField(nameRow, 0);
_firstNameTxtBx.Text = _employee.FirstName;
_lastNameTxtBx = MakeField(nameRow, 244);
_lastNameTxtBx.Text = _employee.LastName;
```

And `MakeField`:

```csharp
private static TextBox MakeField(Panel parent, int x)
{
    return new TextBox
    {
        Location = new Point(x, 20),
        Size = new Size(220, 28),
        ...
    };
    // ← parent.Controls.Add(...) is MISSING
}
```

So the textboxes are created, positioned, but **never added to `nameRow`**. The panel sits there empty. That's why the screenshot shows no First/Last name fields.

## The fix

Replace **two things** in `FrmEditEmployee.cs`:

**1. Fix `MakeField` so it adds the textbox to the parent:**

```csharp
private static TextBox MakeField(Panel parent, int x)
{
    var txt = new TextBox
    {
        Location = new Point(x, 20),
        Size = new Size(220, 28),
        Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9.5f),
        BorderStyle = BorderStyle.FixedSingle,
    };
    parent.Controls.Add(txt);
    return txt;
}
```

**2. Add labels above the two fields in `nameRow`.** Right now the panel has no labels — just the two textboxes at y=20. Add "First name *" and "Last name *" labels at y=0.

Replace this block in `BuildLayout()`:

```csharp
var nameRow = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 68 };
_firstNameTxtBx = MakeField(nameRow, 0);
_firstNameTxtBx.Text = _employee.FirstName;
_lastNameTxtBx = MakeField(nameRow, 244);
_lastNameTxtBx.Text = _employee.LastName;
```

With:

```csharp
var nameRow = new Panel { Dock = DockStyle.Top, Height = 68 };

var firstNameLabel = new Label
{
    Text = "First name *",
    Location = new Point(0, 0),
    AutoSize = true,
    Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
    ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
};
var lastNameLabel = new Label
{
    Text = "Last name *",
    Location = new Point(244, 0),
    AutoSize = true,
    Font = BrandPalette.BrandFontRegular(9f),
    ForeColor = BrandPalette.NeutralTextMuted,
};

_firstNameTxtBx = MakeField(nameRow, 0);
_firstNameTxtBx.Text = _employee.FirstName;
_lastNameTxtBx = MakeField(nameRow, 244);
_lastNameTxtBx.Text = _employee.LastName;

nameRow.Controls.Add(firstNameLabel);
nameRow.Controls.Add(lastNameLabel);
```

## Apply and test

1. **Fix `MakeField`** (add `parent.Controls.Add(txt);`).
2. **Add the two labels** in `nameRow`.
3. **Rebuild.**
4. **Log in as Kyle (Admin).** Manage Users → select an employee → click "Edit Details".
5. **The modal should now show:**
   - First name field (with "First name *" label above it)
   - Last name field (with "Last name *" label above it)
   - Contact number
   - Email
   - Role
   - Cancel / Save Changes
